English: Goodbye.
Chinese: 再见。

English: Farewell.
Chinese: 告辞。

English: Can I ask you some questions?
Chinese: 我能问你几个问题吗?

English: Okay, I think I get it.
Chinese: 好的,我明白了。

English: Got it.
Chinese: 明白了。

English: Actually, I had other questions.
Chinese: 其实,我还有别的问题。

English: That's all I wanted to know.
Chinese: 我想了解的就这些了。

English: <<The device lurches on unstable legs, thick blood oozing from its seams with each shuddering movement. >>
Chinese: <<那台装置用不稳的腿踉跄着,每次颤抖的挪动,都有浓稠的血液从接缝中渗出。>>

English: <<A woman's voice, hoarse and raspy, echoes from within the device.>>##Your service is... ((required)), prisoner XVII.
Chinese: <<一个女人的声音,嘶哑粗粝,从装置内部传出。>>##你的效劳……是((必需的)),十七号囚犯。

English: That's not my name.
Chinese: 那不是我的名字。

English: <<A cackle lapses into a sputter of coughs.>> ##You forfeited... the ((right)) to a name, when you betrayed... the [[Apostatic Union.]] A number is all you deserve.
Chinese: <<一声怪笑变成一串咳嗽。>>##你背弃……[[叛教联盟]]的那一刻,就丧失了……拥有名字的((权利))。一个编号就是你应得的全部。

English: But I offer you the chance of penance. An opportunity to atone... for your vulgar crimes.
Chinese: 但我给你一个赎罪的机会。一个为你的卑劣罪行……偿罪的机会。

English: I'm not gonna take orders from a coffin.
Chinese: 我可不听一口棺材的命令。

English: Uh... do you need some help?
Chinese: 呃……你需要帮忙吗?

English: <<A cackle lapses into a sputter of coughs.>> ##This iron coffin is an honour, a ((privilege.)) The pain it delivers... only serves to sharpen my reason.
Chinese: <<一声怪笑变成一串咳嗽。>>##这口铁棺是荣耀,是((恩典))。它带来的痛苦……只会让我的理智更加锋利。

English: Your base crimes against the [[Apostatic Union]] would not merit... such exquisite torment. But I can offer you redemption of a... different kind.
Chinese: 你针对[[叛教联盟]]的卑劣罪行,本不配……如此精妙的折磨。但我可以给你另一种……救赎。

English: I am the [[High Confessor]] of this... [[Inquisition]] combat tribunal. We are tracking the most dangerous of criminals. ##And ((you))... will help us.
Chinese: 我是这所……[[宗教裁判所]]战斗法庭的[[至高忏悔者]]。我们正在追捕最危险的罪犯。##而((你))……会帮助我们。

English: How, exactly?
Chinese: 具体怎么做?

English: There's no way I'm helping the Inquisition.
Chinese: 我绝不可能帮宗教裁判所。

English: <<She wheezes.>> Oh, but you ((will)). Your sentence... obligates such military service. Refusal would result in... ((unspeakable)) horrors performed on your person. ##So... listen closely.
Chinese: <<她喘息着。>>哦,但你会((愿意的))。你的判决……要求这种兵役。拒绝的话,你的身体将遭受……((难以言喻))的恐怖。##所以……仔细听着。

English: What's in it for me?
Chinese: 对我有什么好处?

English: <<She wheezes.>> You should be glad of such a... ((righteous)) opportunity to serve penance. But success could bring benefits. Even your ((freedom.)) ##So... listen closely.
Chinese: <<她喘息着。>>能得到这样……((正义))的机会服赎罪之刑,你该感到庆幸。但成功会带来好处。甚至是你的((自由))。##所以……仔细听着。

English: Our target's whereabouts have been known... for some time. A backwater archipelago on the very fringes... of Union territory.
Chinese: 我们目标的行踪……早已为人所知。在联盟领土最边缘……的一处偏僻群岛。

English: Known as the [[Oneiric Isles]], these flying islands... are host to a manner of outcasts and miscreants. ##We arrived a few hours ago, but met with... fierce resistance.
Chinese: 这里名为[[梦幻群岛]],这些飞行岛屿……收容着形形色色的流浪者和歹徒。##我们几小时前抵达,却遭遇了……顽强的抵抗。

English: Our target... is in the [[Blinding Light]] fortress; the last remaining holdout of the [[Dark Star Mercenaries...]]
Chinese: 我们的目标……就在[[炫光要塞]];那是[[黑星佣兵]]最后的据点……

English: ...for our quarry is their leader, the notorious... [[Vela Callose]].
Chinese: ……因为我们的猎物正是他们的首领,臭名昭著的……[[薇拉·卡洛斯]]。

English: I guess I have no choice.
Chinese: 我想我没有别的选择。

English: Never heard of her.
Chinese: 没听说过这个人。

English: She is the daughter of Admiral Callose. Groomed for command, but she set off on her own to found a warband... of thieves and pirates.
Chinese: 她是卡洛斯上将的女儿。本是培养来统领军队的,但她自行出走,建立了一支盗贼和海盗的战团……

English: The Dark Stars were tolerated in the Union, until Vela became enthralled with... delusions of grandeur. Claimed she could create... some sort of ((heaven)).
Chinese: 黑星佣兵团在联盟本来是被容忍的,直到薇拉迷上了……狂妄的妄想。声称自己能创造……某种((天堂))。

English: ((Vela Callose?)) This is suicide!
Chinese: ((薇拉·卡洛斯?))这是自杀!

English: Not so. It is true that our agents have met with... fierce resistance. But my drones calculate a... one in three-hundred-and-sixty-four chance of success. It's ((entirely)) possible.
Chinese: 并非如此。确实,我们的特工遭遇了……顽强的抵抗。但我的无人机计算出……三百六十四分之一的机会。((完全))有可能。

English: Before you go, take this [[Inquisition Journal.]] ## <<A mechanical arm thrusts a peculiar device in your direction.>>## It will keep track of your mission.
Chinese: 在你出发前,收下这本[[宗教裁判所日志]]。##<<一条机械臂把一个古怪的装置伸向你。>>##它会记录你的任务。

English: My [[drones]] can offer guidance. And closer to the Blinding Light, [[Inquisitor Ignavus]] can assist you further.
Chinese: 我的[[无人机]]可以提供指引。靠近炫光要塞时,[[伊格纳修斯审判官]]能给你进一步协助。

English: Oh and... don't try to run. These [[flying islands]] are... unstable, and many a fool has fallen to their death.
Chinese: 哦还有……别想逃跑。这些[[飞行岛屿]]……并不稳定,许多蠢货已经坠亡。

English: <<As you approach, the Inquisitor takes in a deep breath of air.>> Do you ((smell)) that, Prisoner XVII?
Chinese: <<你走近时,审判官深深吸了一口气。>>你((闻))到了吗,十七号囚犯?

English: Uh... Engine grease?
Chinese: 呃……引擎油脂?

English: <<He shakes his head.>> These Inquisition ships run on odourless cipher magic; state of the art from those boffins at the Erudite Academy.
Chinese: <<他摇头。>>宗教裁判所的船靠无味的密文魔法驱动;那是博识学院那帮学究的最先进成果。

English: No, I was actually talking about... <<he breathes in.>> ((mushroom spores)).
Chinese: 不,我其实说的是……<<他吸气。>>((蘑菇孢子))。

English: Uh... The smoke of battle?
Chinese: 呃……战斗的硝烟?

English: <<He sniffs exactly twice.>> I suppose there ((is)) a hint of that.
Chinese: <<他不偏不倚地嗅了两下。>>我想((确实))有一点那个味道。

English: But I was actually talking about... <<he breathes in.>> ((mushroom spores)).
Chinese: 但我其实说的是……<<他吸气。>>((蘑菇孢子))。

English: Uh... Mushrooms?
Chinese: 呃……蘑菇?

English: <<He clicks his fingers.>> ((Exactly))!
Chinese: <<他打了个响指。>>((正是))!

English: <<He turns to you, a beaming smile across his face.>> ##I've never seen this many mushrooms in my ((life.))
Chinese: <<他转向你,满脸灿烂的笑容。>>##我((这辈子))从没见过这么多蘑菇。

English: Such wide stalks. Such healthy gills. <<He takes a long breath.>> Ah, and such ((potent)) spores! ##We have mushroom forests back home in Lundel, but nothing like this.
Chinese: 多么宽的菌柄。多么健康的菌褶。<<他深深吸了一口气。>>啊,还有这么((有力))的孢子!##我们老家伦德尔也有蘑菇森林,但从没见过这样的。

English: <<He waggles a finger at you, while turning his gaze back at the mushrooms.>> ##Prisoner XVII, if you get back alive, remind me to get a batch of [[Scryshroom Tea]] for my wife. They make it here in the Oneiric Isles, and I hear it's to ((die)) for.
Chinese: <<他朝你摆了摆手指,目光又转回蘑菇。>>##十七号囚犯,你要是活着回来,提醒我给我妻子带一批[[窥菇茶]]。梦幻群岛这边产的,听说好得要((死))。

English: Um, okay.
Chinese: 呃,好啊。

English: <<He slaps you on the shoulder.>> That's damn good of you, Prisoner. ##Ah, but where are my manners?
Chinese: <<他拍了拍你的肩膀。>>你可真够意思,囚犯。##啊,瞧我这礼数。

English: Um, no.
Chinese: 呃,不行。

English: <<He frowns.>> You know, you're right, Prisoner. We've not even been introduced and I'm already asking for favours. That was damn impolite of me.
Chinese: <<他皱眉。>>你知道吗,你说得对,囚犯。我们还没正式认识,我就开始求人办事。我真是非常失礼。

English: Um, who are you?
Chinese: 呃,你是谁?

English: <<He slaps himself on the forehead.>> Ah, where are my manners?
Chinese: <<他拍了拍自己的额头。>>啊,瞧我这礼数。

English: <<He holds out his hand in greeting.>> ##Inquisitor Ignavius of the Twelfth Inquisitorial Tribunal, pleased to make your acquaintance.
Chinese: <<他伸出手致意。>>##第十二裁判法庭审判官伊格纳修斯,幸会幸会。

English: ((Shake his hand firmly.))
Chinese: ((用力握住他的手。))

English: <<He grips your hand with an equal firmness.>> I see I'm in good company, Prisoner.
Chinese: <<他以同样的力道握住你的手。>>看来你是个靠谱的人,囚犯。

English: ((Slap his hand away.))
Chinese: ((把他的手拍开。))

English: <<He laughs.>> A classic ((Slevian Slap)). Well, it'll do.
Chinese: <<他大笑。>>经典的((斯列夫式耳光))。好吧,也凑合。

English: What are we ((doing)) here, Ignavius?
Chinese: 我们来这里是((干什么))的,伊格纳修斯?

English: <<He pulls his hand back.>> Hmph, straight to business, eh Prisoner? So be it.
Chinese: <<他收回手。>>哼,直奔正题是吧,囚犯?那就依你。

English: <<He points at the fortress ahead.>> That's the [[Blinding Light]] - the fortress of Vela Callose, leader of the Dark Star mercenaries.
Chinese: <<他指着前方的堡垒。>>那是[[炫光要塞]]——黑星佣兵首领薇拉·卡洛斯的堡垒。

English: The High Confessor told me you'd be joining the assault. And not a moment too soon - we need all the help we can get.
Chinese: 至高忏悔者告诉我你会参加强攻。来得正是时候——我们需要一切能得到的帮助。

English: I've sent all my agents, but so far none have reported back. We expected heavy fighting, but it seems those Dark Star ruffians are a tougher bunch than we gave them credit for.
Chinese: 我派出了所有特工,但至今没有一个回报。我们预料到会有激战,但看来那帮黑星恶徒比我们想象的更难缠。

English: Your orders are to [[capture Vela alive]]. A tall order, I'll admit - but I think you're up to the job, Prisoner. ##So - any questions?
Chinese: 你的命令是[[活捉薇拉]]。我承认,这是件苦差——但我觉得你能胜任,囚犯。##那么——有什么问题吗?

English: How do I get to the Blinding Light?
Chinese: 我怎么进炫光要塞?

English: Why, do you see that great big [[cannon]] looming overhead? That's part of the Blinding Light fortress, and is where you need to get to.
Chinese: 哎,你看见头顶那门巨大的[[加农炮]]了吗?那是炫光要塞的一部分,也是你要去的地方。

English: Just stride into that main gate, making sure to slay any pesky Dark Stars that get in your way. Once you're in the compound, find a [[lift mechanism]] that will take you up the [[battlements]]. That's where Vela has been holed up.
Chinese: 直接大步走进那道正门,顺手解决掉挡路的讨厌黑星。进了大院后,找一个[[升降机关]],它会把你送上[[城垛]]。薇拉就一直躲在那儿。

English: Is there a way I can avoid bloodshed?
Chinese: 有没有办法避免流血?

English: Ah, the ((sneaky)) sort, are we? Well, you're in luck. My agents reported that there's a [[side entrance]] to the right of the fortress, which leads into a maintenance tunnel of some sort. I'm sure the Dark Stars laid plenty of [[traps]], but surely nothing you couldn't disarm with a deft hand, eh?
Chinese: 啊,是喜欢((偷偷摸摸))的路子,是吧?那你的运气不错。我的特工报告说,要塞右侧有一道[[侧门]],通向某种维护通道。我敢肯定黑星们布置了不少[[陷阱]],但凭你灵巧的双手,肯定都能拆掉,对吧?

English: Once you're inside, you could try and [[avoid detection]] by keeping to the walls. These old God War forts have plenty of nooks and crannies, so just... <<he puts a finger to his lips,>> keep quiet and out of sight, yes?
Chinese: 进去之后,你可以贴着墙走,尽量[[避免被发现]]。这些古老的神战堡垒有的是角落和缝隙,所以……<<他把手指竖在唇边,>>保持安静,别露头,好吗?

English: What if I want to practise my combat skills?
Chinese: 要是我练练战斗技能呢?

English: Ah, well we established a small boot camp of sorts, just here! I always make sure to remind my combat echelon of the fundamentals before a tricky mission, so you'll find plenty of [[target dummies]] and [[tutorial signs]] just below.
Chinese: 啊,我们正好在这儿建了个小型训练营!每逢棘手任务,我总会提醒战斗梯队复习基础,所以下面有不少[[靶桩]]和[[教学标牌]]。

English: I need to know more about Vela and this mission.
Chinese: 我需要多了解一些薇拉和这次任务的事。

English: <<He nods.>> Yes, I'm sure you have plenty of questions. What do you want to know?
Chinese: <<他点头。>>是的,你肯定有不少问题。想知道什么?

English: Okay, I guess I'll get going.
Chinese: 好吧,我想我该出发了。

English: <<His smile beams.>> Ah, that's the spirit, prisoner. I'm sure you'll make short work of those ruffians.
Chinese: <<他笑容满面。>>啊,这就对了,囚犯。我相信你会干脆利落地解决那帮恶棍。

English: And when you're done, be sure to [[check in with me]] after the mission. I've taken quite an interest in these Oneiric Isles of late, and I'm sure I can fill you in with plenty of [[useful tidbits.]]
Chinese: 完事之后,任务结束记得[[来向我报到]]。近来我对梦幻群岛兴趣浓厚,肯定能给你讲不少[[有用的见闻]]。

English: <<He grins.>> Inquisitor Ignavius of the Twelfth Inquisitorial Tribunal, pleased to make your acquaintance.
Chinese: <<他咧嘴笑。>>第十二裁判法庭审判官伊格纳修斯,幸会幸会。

English: As the Second Inquisitor of this tribunal, you can address me with any queries that may be too ((trifling)) for the High Confessor's attention. Together, I'm sure we'll catch this Vela scoundrel in a jiffy.
Chinese: 作为本法庭的第二审判官,任何对至高忏悔者而言太((琐碎))的问题,都可以来问我。我相信我们一起很快就能抓住薇拉这个恶棍。

English: <<He takes in a deep breath.>> And in the meantime, we can bask in this delightful countryside. There are such ((potent)) spores here! I bet the [[Scryshroom Tea]] is to ((die)) for.
Chinese: <<他深吸一口气。>>等待期间,我们可以尽情享受这可爱的乡野。这里的孢子多么((有力))!我打赌这边的[[窥菇茶]]好得要((死))。

English: Ah, Confessor XVII! I just ((knew)) you'd survive the assault. The drones were all but ((certain)) you'd meet a gruesome end, but you sure showed them, eh?
Chinese: 啊,十七号忏悔者!我((就知道))你能在强攻中活下来。无人机们几乎((笃定))你会死得很难看,可你狠狠打了它们的脸,对吧?

English: Greetings, Confessor! Have you stopped in for a little chat? How delightful.
Chinese: 你好啊,忏悔者!是停下来聊聊天吗?太好了。

English: <<He grins.>> Inquisitor Ignavius of the Twelfth Inquisitorial Tribunal, pleased to make your acquaintance.
Chinese: <<他咧嘴笑。>>第十二裁判法庭审判官伊格纳修斯,幸会幸会。

English: Terribly unfortunate business with the High Confessor, eh? I always thought she was a damn fine woman, but who'd have thought she'd have such ((skeletons)) in her coffin? Uh, I mean closet. Bad choice of phrase, there.
Chinese: 至高忏悔者那事儿真是不幸,对吧?我一直觉得她是个了不起的女人,可谁想得到她((棺材))里藏着骷髅?呃,我是说柜子里。这比喻选得真糟。

English: Anyway, it looks like I'm the acting High Inquisitor of this tribunal, while this matter is reserved. Quite the responsibility, eh? I might need some wine to steady my nerves...
Chinese: 总之,趁此事搁置期间,看来我就是本法庭的代理首席审判官了。责任重大啊,对吧?我可能需要点酒来稳住神经……

English: As for ((your)) duties? Uh... well... I would simply carry on with what you were doing, uh... whatever that was.
Chinese: 至于((你))的职责?呃……嗯……你就继续做你之前做的事吧,呃……不管那是什么。

English: Confessor, the drones have informed me that there's been an awful lot of commotion in the lower decks - as if some of our guests have been ((preparing)) for something. But of course, I told them you couldn't possibly be organising anything, as our orders are to stand down for the foreseeable future!
Chinese: 忏悔者,无人机向我报告说下层甲板闹得厉害——好像我们的一些客人正在((筹备))什么事。不过我当然跟它们说了,你不可能在组织什么,因为我们的命令是可预见的未来内原地待命!

English: Anyway, just keep the racket down, you hear? I know it's terribly ((boring)) waiting around like this, but if you could keep your strange hobbies ((away)) from the ship? Much obliged.
Chinese: 总之,把动静弄小点,听见了吗?我知道像这样干等着十分((无聊)),但你能不能把那些奇怪的癖好((离))这条船远一点?多谢了。

English: Ah, Confessor XVII! All going well, I hope?
Chinese: 啊,十七号忏悔者!一切顺利吧,我希望?

English: Ah, Prisoner XVII! All going well, I hope?
Chinese: 啊,十七号囚犯!一切顺利吧,我希望?

English: I got you some Musroom Wine.
Chinese: 我给你带了点蘑菇酒。

English: Confessor! This is entirely unexpected. How thoughtful of you.
Chinese: 忏悔者!这真是意外之喜。你想得真周到。

English: <<He removes from his belt a tiny metal goblet. He uncorks the wine and gently pours it before taking a sip.>>
Chinese: <<他从腰带上取下一只小小的金属酒杯。他打开酒塞,轻轻倒了一杯,抿了一口。>>

English: <<He frowns, and is silent a moment.>> ##Confessor, this is... ((excuse me))...
Chinese: <<他皱起眉,沉默了片刻。>>##忏悔者,这酒……((失陪一下))……

English: ...((Damn)) fine wine!
Chinese: ……((真他妈))是好酒!

English: <<He takes another sip.>> I've tried an extraordinary number of vintages in my time, and this - this is one of the best.
Chinese: <<他又抿了一口。>>我这辈子喝过的酒不计其数,而这——这是其中最好的之一。

English: My wife is going to love it. Please, take this in recompense.
Chinese: 我妻子一定会爱死它。请收下这个作为回礼。

English: About the mission...
Chinese: 关于任务……

English: Ah, yes! What about it?
Chinese: 啊,好!任务怎么了?

English: Tell me about Vela and the Dark Stars.
Chinese: 跟我讲讲薇拉和黑星佣兵团。

English: Vela Callose. Now ((that's)) a name that'll make hairs stand on end.
Chinese: 薇拉·卡洛斯。这名字现在((可是))能让人汗毛倒竖。

English: She's the daughter of old Admiral Callose of the Apostatic Union Navy - but instead of following in her father's footsteps, she founded the most accomplished mercenary band since the God War.
Chinese: 她是叛教联盟海军老上将卡洛斯的女儿——但她没有子承父业,而是创立了神之战以来最出类拔萃的佣兵团。

English: Sure, she's currently the most wanted criminal in the Union. But you've got to hand it to her - for years, the Union itself relied on Vela and her Dark Stars to do the jobs the Navy were unwilling - or ((unable)) - to do themselves.
Chinese: 没错,她如今是联盟的头号通缉犯。但你不得不佩服她——多年来,联盟自己都依靠薇拉和她的黑星,去做那些海军不愿——或((不能))——亲自动手的活儿。

English: <<He sighs.>> It's a pity she turned down such a dark path. In the later years of the Dark Stars, their number of villainous deeds far exceeded those of noble intent.
Chinese: <<他叹气。>>可惜她走上了这么黑暗的道路。黑星后期,恶行的数量远远超过了义举。

English: What of the Dark Stars' villany, then?
Chinese: 那么黑星的恶行都有哪些?

English: Well, there was the Astral College heist in Byonne, where they made off with an ((artificed star)) among other priceless treasures. ##Then there was the sinking of the merchant freighter Popinjay, and all those hostages slaughtered at the Siege of Saracolco... ((I could go on)).
Chinese: 嗯,拜昂星象学院盗窃案,他们卷走了一颗((人造星))和无数奇珍异宝。##还有商船"波品杰号"沉没事件,以及萨拉科尔科围城战里被屠戮的那些人质……((我可以说上一天))。

English: In the end, they say she lost the plot. Started yammering about some sort of ((heaven)). The Inquisition ruled this was tantamount to cultism - ((Article CXII, claims of a religious nature)) - and warranted her arrest.
Chinese: 到最后,人们说她疯了。开始念叨什么((天堂))。宗教裁判所裁定这等同于邪教行为——((第112条,涉及宗教性质的言论))——应当将其逮捕。

English: Of course, I think the Polymaths over in Riova had wanted her gone long before all this. Got too big for her boots, and finally they had their warrant. ##Even Vela's ((own)) mercs got so riled up they mutinied against her.
Chinese: 当然,我觉得里奥瓦的那些博学家早就想除掉她了。她太嚣张,他们总算等到了逮捕令。##连薇拉((自己))的佣兵都被煽动起来,反叛了她。

English: She's been hiding out here for years, but the Inquisition finally got the go-ahead to make a move - so here we are.
Chinese: 她在这里躲了好些年,但宗教裁判所终于得到许可采取行动——于是我们就来了。

English: Thanks for the info.
Chinese: 多谢提供情报。

English: Of course. Was that all?
Chinese: 不客气。就这些吗?

English: Why are you using prisoners like me?
Chinese: 为什么要用我这样的囚犯?

English: <<He grins.>> Ah, because rigorous labour is a tonic for the ills of one's ((mind))!
Chinese: <<他咧嘴笑。>>啊,因为严格的劳役是治疗((心灵))疾病的良药!

English: We're not like some common judiciary back in Union homeland, where prisoners are thrown in a pit with a scrap of mouldy bread, no matter their crime.
Chinese: 我们可不像联盟本土那些普通司法机构,把囚犯扔进坑里,丢一块发霉的面包,不管罪行轻重。

English: <<He taps his forehead.>> We recognise the ((twisted intellect)) of our guests. And if we can ((un))-twist that reason with the right application of punitive employment, we will have enlightened the world, just a little.
Chinese: <<他敲了敲额头。>>我们识别出客人们((扭曲的才智))。若能用恰当的劳役惩处把那份理智((掰直)),我们就为世界点亮了一丝明灯。

English: <<He clears his throat.>> We're also authorised to use any method at our disposal when a mission is going... Ah.. how do they say it in Slev? ((Udders up)).
Chinese: <<他清了清嗓子。>>当任务进行得……啊……斯列夫人是怎么说的来着?((四脚朝天))。

English: What do you think of the High Confessor?
Chinese: 你觉得至高忏悔者这个人怎么样?

English: <<He strokes his chin.>> Many in the Inquisition think it a ((travesty)) that a Confessor - that is, a prisoner still serving their penance - has been granted control of an entire Tribunal. Normally, it would be the job of a High Inquisitor.
Chinese: <<他摸着下巴。>>宗教裁判所里许多人都认为,让一个忏悔者——也就是仍在服赎罪刑期的囚犯——执掌整个法庭,是一种((荒唐))。通常,这本该是首席审判官的职责。

English: Indeed, there's also the ((nature)) of her crimes, and how they relate to the very criminal she has been tasked to apprehend...
Chinese: 何况,她罪行的((性质)),以及与她奉命追捕的那位罪犯之间的关联,也颇有争议……

English: But personally? I think, despite her ((quirks)), she's proved herself as one of the most accomplished agents within our ranks.
Chinese: 但就我个人而言?我觉得,尽管她有些((怪癖)),她已经证明自己是我们队伍中最出色的特工之一。

English: That's all I wanted to know.
Chinese: 我想了解的就这些了。

English: Splendid. Was there anything else?
Chinese: 太好了。还有别的事吗?

English: I had questions about the Skyrealms.
Chinese: 我有些关于天空领域的问题。

English: By all means, ask away.
Chinese: 请便,尽管问。

English: Tell me about the Apostatic Union.
Chinese: 跟我讲讲叛教联盟。

English: <<He glanced you up and down.>> Well surely you've ((been)) there - Union ((heartland)), I mean?
Chinese: <<他上下打量你。>>你肯定((去过))那里吧——我是说联盟((本土))?

English: Well, the Union is the most ((civilised)) place in the Skyrealms since the World Rend. You may not agree, but to my mind it's the truth.
Chinese: 嗯,自世界撕裂以来,联盟是天空领域最((文明))的地方。你可以不同意,但在我看来这就是事实。

English: What's its history?
Chinese: 它的历史是怎样的?

English: For the past four hundred years, the skyrealms have been under the control of the Wikkan covens and their gods. It may be true that some preached tolerance - but others were tyrants who twisted their poor followers into cruelty and ignorance. This you cannot dispute.
Chinese: 过去四百年,天空领域一直处在维坎教团及其诸神的控制之下。也许有些确实宣扬宽容——但也有暴君把他们可怜的信徒扭曲成残忍与愚昧。这一点你无法否认。

English: You see, the Wikkans acted no different from the worst Slevian cartels. They forbade the weaving of cipher magic and the advancement of reasoned debate. They locked us in blood-contracts with gods who stunted our advancement.
Chinese: 你瞧,维坎人的所作所为与最恶劣的斯列夫卡特尔别无二致。他们禁止编织密文魔法,禁止理性辩论的推进。他们用血契把我们锁在那些阻碍我们前进的神身上。

English: But forty years ago, in the God War, the Apostatics cast off our shackles. ##<<He sighs.>> It's true that a lot of blood was spilled - both mortal and divine. But now, in Union territory, reason and discourse have replaced ignorance and fear.
Chinese: 但四十年前,在神之战中,背教者挣脱了枷锁。##<<他叹气。>>确实流了很多血——凡人的和神的都有。但如今,在联盟的领土上,理性与思辨取代了愚昧与恐惧。

English: What's Union heartland like?
Chinese: 联盟本土是什么样子?

English: <<He sniffs.>> Well, depends where you go. I'm from Lundel - a place full of windswept hills, soggy marshes and crumbling castles, circled by a blue neuron star. We also have a... ((weakness)) for ale.
Chinese: <<他吸了吸鼻子。>>嗯,看你去哪儿。我来自伦德尔——那里满是风吹的山丘、湿软的沼泽和残破的城堡,绕着一颗蓝色神经元星运转。我们对麦酒还有点……((难以抗拒))。

English: There's also Byonne, known for its universities and fine wine, and Slev - a rugged, wet land where criminal elements are rife.
Chinese: 还有拜昂,以大学和美酒闻名;以及斯列夫——一片崎岖湿漉之地,犯罪分子横行。

English: But many would consider the most important Union realm to be Vena. It's a warm, beautiful archipelago full of orchards bathed in yellow starlight, and home to the Union's most important city - Riova.
Chinese: 但许多人会认为最重要的联盟疆域是维纳。那是一片温暖美丽的群岛,满是沐浴在黄色星光中的果园,还是联盟最重要城市的所在地——里奥瓦。

English: Riova is where the Union council of Polymaths meet. It's a city full of floating houses all strung together with bridges and ropes, with gondolas drifting between them. When you're in the middle, it's said you can't see a hint of sky; there's buildings in every direction.
Chinese: 里奥瓦是联盟博学家议事会开会的地方。那座城满是漂浮的房屋,由桥梁和绳索连在一起,贡多拉在房屋之间穿行。据说身处城中心时,你连一丝天空都看不见;四面八方全是建筑。

English: But wherever you go in the Union heartlands, there's nowhere as rugged and ((wild)) as this. ##<<He takes a lungful of air.>> Ah! Nary a sewer for miles.
Chinese: 但无论你走到联盟本土的哪里,都没有这里这般粗粝((狂野))。##<<他吸了一大口气。>>啊!方圆数里连一条下水道都没有。

English: That's enough about the Union.
Chinese: 联盟的事就到这里吧。

English: <<He nods.>> Anything else?
Chinese: <<他点头。>>还有别的吗?

English: Tell me about the Oneiric Isles.
Chinese: 跟我讲讲梦幻群岛。

English: Well, the Oneiric Isles are the archipelago we're on now. It's always been at the fringe of Union territory, and has only recently had a regional council installed in Hallowshire.
Chinese: 嗯,梦幻群岛就是我们脚下的这片群岛。它一直处于联盟领土的边缘,直到最近才在哈洛郡设立地区议会。

English: But there are also islands outside of Union control. To the east lies the Clockwork Kingdom, ruled by a machine monarch - while to the west lies a rather frightful place of undying souls, known as the Endless Realm.
Chinese: 但也有联盟管不到的岛屿。东边是发条王国,由一位机器君主统治;西边则是一个相当可怕的、亡魂不灭的地方,人称无尽领域。

English: Tell me about Hallowshire.
Chinese: 跟我讲讲哈洛郡。

English: Though Hallowshire has technically been under Union control since the God War, it's been somewhat... ((neglected)) until recently.
Chinese: 虽然哈洛郡从神之战起名义上就归联盟管辖,但直到最近,它一直多少受到……((冷落))。

English: That means there's still cultists lurking among the hills, not yet flushed out. There are even whispers of ((gods)) lurking in nasty nooks and crannies.
Chinese: 也就是说,山丘间仍有邪教徒潜伏,尚未清除。甚至有传言说,阴暗的角落缝隙里还((潜伏着神明))。

English: But, no need to worry. A Union Council chamber has just been built in Hallow Town, and this place now has its very own Polymath! With such an esteemed education, she'll have this place sorted out in no time.
Chinese: 不过,不必担心。哈洛镇刚建成一座联盟议事厅,这地方现在也有了自己的博学家!受过那么高等的教育,她很快就能把这里收拾妥当。

English: Tell me about the Clockwork Kingdom.
Chinese: 跟我讲讲发条王国。

English: Hmph, well the less said about that place, the better. It used to be known as [[Kardova]], and during the God War they aided the apostatics in overthrowing the Wikkans and their gods. They even made the Blinding Light fortress, as well as many other war machines.
Chinese: 哼,那地方还是少提为妙。它以前叫[[卡尔多瓦]],神之战期间,他们协助背教者推翻了维坎教团和他们的诸神。炫光要塞就是他们造的,还有许多其他战争机器。

English: But they always were a little big for their boots. Despite having the best alchemists and aetherists in the Skyrealms, they got the mad notion of making some sort of ((magical utopia)) where every foolish peasant could cast a spell. Utter nonsense, I say.
Chinese: 但他们向来有点自不量力。明明坐拥天空领域最好的炼金师和乙太师,却起了疯狂的念头,要打造某种((魔法乌托邦)),让每个愚蠢的农夫都能施法。依我说,纯粹胡闹。

English: Only, for a while it seemed like the buggers actually got it to ((work)). The stuff that was coming out of the newly formed Clockwork Kingdom was making even the Erudite Academy scholars blush with envy!
Chinese: 只不过,有那么一阵子,那帮家伙好像真把它((弄成))了。新生的发条王国拿出的东西,连博识学院的学者都嫉妒得脸红!

English: At least, until their mechanical King went mad, and threw the whole place into chaos. Now it's a frozen wasteland full of malfunctioning robots and rotting crops.
Chinese: 至少,在他们那台机械国王发疯、把整个国家搅得天翻地覆之前是这样。如今那里是一片冰封的荒地,满是故障的机器人和烂在地里的庄稼。

English: Which is a ((damn)) shame, because there was a lovely little teahouse in Ferropolis that my wife ((adored)). Ah, well.
Chinese: 这真是((太))可惜了,因为铁城里有一家可爱的小茶馆,我妻子((特别钟爱))。唉,算了。

English: Tell me about the Endless Realm.
Chinese: 跟我讲讲无尽领域。

English: Did you ever hear the stories of the Cadaver Crusades? Led by those nasty ghouls that plundered the living to eat their flesh? <<He visibly shivers.>>
Chinese: 你听说过尸骸十字军的故事吗?那群可恶的食尸鬼带头劫掠活人、吞食血肉?<<他明显打了个寒战。>>

English: Well, turns out those weren't just stories. Those monsters actually ((exist)), and have a little kingdom right over yonder, ruled by their so-called Queen of Silver! I tell you, you couldn't make it up.
Chinese: 嗯,结果那些不只是故事。那些怪物真的((存在)),就在那边有个小王国,由他们所谓的白银女王统治!我跟你说,编都编不出来。

English: Last I heard, they packed in all that flesh-eating business, and started farming some sort of... ((mindless meat)). Fancy that - ghouls with a conscience!
Chinese: 我最后一次听说,他们收起了吃人的营生,开始养殖某种……((无意识的肉))。真是稀奇——食尸鬼也有良心了!

English: What island are we on now?
Chinese: 我们现在在哪座岛上?

English: Oh, this little isle is known as [[Pwyll]]. Just a handful of mushroom farmers here, really - but its remote location has always made it a haven for smugglers and pirates.
Chinese: 哦,这座小岛叫[[普威尔]]。这里其实只有寥寥几个蘑菇农——但地处偏远,向来是走私贩和海盗的避风港。

English: Perhaps that's why Vela came here to lick her wounds, after the Dark Start mutiny.
Chinese: 也许正因如此,薇拉才在黑星叛变后来到这里舔舐伤口。

English: That's all I wanted to know about these islands.
Chinese: 关于这些群岛我想知道的就这些了。

English: Very good. Was there anything else?
Chinese: 很好。还有别的事吗?

English: Tell me about yourself.
Chinese: 跟我讲讲你自己吧。

English: Me? Oh, there's not much to tell - I'm just a humble servant of the Apostatic Union.
Chinese: 我?哦,没什么好讲的——我只是叛教联盟的一个谦卑仆人。

English: Time ago I was a councillor, would you believe. Only... a rather ((embarrassing incident)) involving a lost shipment of hallucinogenic scryshrooms saw me... ((ahem)) demoted to a less public facing role.
Chinese: 信不信由你,很久以前我还是个议员呢。只是……一起相当((难堪的事件))——一批致幻窥菇失踪——让我……((咳咳))被降职到了不太抛头露面的岗位。

English: So here I am, working for the esteemed Inquisition. Only, one can't help if their thoughts often drift to home comforts, eh? I have a lovely little cottage back in Lundel with my wife. One day I'll pack all this in, and get back to growing button caps in my garden.
Chinese: 于是我就到了这儿,为受人尊敬的宗教裁判所效力。只是,人的思绪难免常常飘回家中的安逸,对吧?我在伦德尔和妻子有一座可爱的小屋。总有一天我会辞掉这一切,回去在园子里种纽扣菇。

English: That's all the questions I had.
Chinese: 我的问题就这些了。

English: Excellent. Now, will there be anything else?
Chinese: 太好了。那么,还有别的需要吗?

English: Goodbye.
Chinese: 再见。

English: Best of luck out there.
Chinese: 祝你在外好运。

English: I got you some Scryshroom Tea.
Chinese: 我给你带了些窥菇茶。

English: Ah, Confessor! This is exactly what I was looking for. How thoughtful of you.
Chinese: 啊,忏悔者!这正是我想要的。你想得真周到。

English: <<He removes from his belt a tiny metal teapot. He slips some loose tea in the filter, and to your surprise, you notice it already contains boiling water.>> ##If you would be so kind as to wait a moment, Confessor - I really must let this brew.
Chinese: <<他从腰带上取下一只小小的金属茶壶。他把散茶放进滤网,让你惊讶的是,你发现里面已经装着滚烫的开水。>>##请稍等片刻,忏悔者——这茶必须泡到位。

English: <<You wait for an uncomfortable few minutes, in total silence, while the Inquisitor stares at his miniature teapot.>> ##<<Finally he seems satisfied. He pours the liquid into a cup and takes a sip.>>
Chinese: <<你在尴尬的寂静中等了几分钟,审判官盯着他的迷你茶壶。>>##<<他终于似乎满意了。他把茶水倒进杯子,抿了一口。>>

English: <<He frowns, and is silent a moment.>> ##Confessor, this is... ((excuse me))...
Chinese: <<他皱起眉,沉默了片刻。>>##忏悔者,这茶……((失陪一下))……

English: ...((Damn)) fine tea!
Chinese: ……((真他妈))是好茶!

English: My wife is going to love it. Please, take this in recompense.
Chinese: 我妻子一定会爱死它。请收下这个作为回礼。

English: <<He takes another sip.>> I've tried an extraordinary number of teas in my time, and this - this is one of the best. ##My wife is going to love it. Please, take this in recompense.
Chinese: <<他又抿了一口。>>我这辈子喝过的茶不计其数,而这——这是其中最好的之一。##我妻子一定会爱死它。请收下这个作为回礼。

English: <<Beads of sweat appear on the Inquisitor's forehead, and he seems to be staring at something only he can see. He mutters to himself,>> ((Damn fine tea, indeed...)) ##<<You think it is probably best to leave him be.>>
Chinese: <<审判官的额头上渗出汗珠,他似乎盯着什么只有他自己看得见的东西,喃喃自语,>>((真是好茶,好极了……))##<<你觉得最好还是别打扰他。>>

English: Ah, Prisoner XVII, I believe you are wanted by the [[High Confessor.]] Best not to keep her waiting, yes?
Chinese: 啊,十七号囚犯,[[至高忏悔者]]要见你。最好别让她久等,好吗?

English: But by all means, come back and speak to me afterwards; we've much to discuss.
Chinese: 不过当然,回头再来找我聊聊;我们有很多要谈的。

English: About that tea you wanted...
Chinese: 关于你想要的那茶……

English: Yes - [[Scryshroom Tea]], for my wife. They make it here in [[Pwyll Village]], just south down the road from the Blinding Light fortress.
Chinese: 对——[[窥菇茶]],给我妻子的。[[普威尔村]]就有产,就在炫光要塞沿路往南。

English: Ah, that's very good of you, confessor - but let's wait until this assault is over, yes? Come meet me in the [[Blinding Light]] once we've apprehended this Vela woman.
Chinese: 啊,你真是太好了,忏悔者——不过咱们等强攻结束再说,好吗?等我们抓住那个薇拉女人,就到[[炫光要塞]]来找我。

English: What was that tea, again?
Chinese: 那个茶叫什么来着?

English: Never mind.
Chinese: 算了。

English: Oh, it's ((you.)) ##The [[High Confessor]] wants to speak with you, up on the platform.
Chinese: 哦,是((你))啊。##[[至高忏悔者]]要跟你谈话,在平台上面。

English: <<He mutter under his breath,>> ((Though what she sees in a wretched prisoner is beyond me.))
Chinese: <<他低声嘀咕,>>((不过她看上一个可怜囚犯哪一点,我就搞不懂了。))

English: So, she gave you the rank of [[Confessor]], eh? Well, I suppose we'll be working together, then...
Chinese: 所以,她给了你[[忏悔者]]的头衔,是吧?好吧,那看来我们要共事了……

English: Just remember - the rank of Confessor will stick to you like a birthmark. It marks you as a ((prisoner)), seeking penitence through duty. Even ((she)) cannot escape that tainted rank.
Chinese: 记住——忏悔者的头衔会像胎记一样跟着你。它标明你是个((囚犯)),以服刑赎罪。连((她))也逃不开这肮脏的头衔。

English: <<You catch a beaming smile behind the agent's visor.>> Ah, so you're the one who squared up to Vela? And to think, we had you locked in a cell!
Chinese: <<你在特工的面甲后看见一抹灿烂的笑容。>>啊,你就是敢跟薇拉正面交手的人?想想看,我们居然还把你关在牢里!

English: <<The agent chuckles.>> Well, you really showed ((us)) how it's done. ##Anyway, I think the [[High Confessor]] wants to see you. I wouldn't keep her waiting...
Chinese: <<特工轻笑。>>你真是让((我们))见识了什么叫高手。##总之,我想[[至高忏悔者]]要见你。别让她久等……

English: Oh, if it isn't our newest Confessor! <<She bows her head politely.>>
Chinese: 哦,这不是我们最新的忏悔者嘛!<<她礼貌地低头致意。>>

English: I'd love to help you with your mission, but I don't have the security clearance to know all the ins-and-outs. You should speak with [[Inquisitor Ignavius]], on the platform opposite the High Confessor. ((He'll)) know what to do.
Chinese: 我很想在任务上帮你,可我没有权限了解全部细节。你应该去和[[伊格纳修斯审判官]]谈谈,就在至高忏悔者对面的平台上。((他))知道该怎么做。

English: Hmph, you the one they sent from the Twelfth Tribunal?
Chinese: 哼,你们第十二法庭派来的就是你?

English: Like I told my handler, it's just a Class F godlet - ((our)) tribunal has this under control. No idea why we have to wait for some fool from your bunch of prisoners and misfits.
Chinese: 我跟我的联络人说过,不过是个F级稚神——((我们))法庭完全控制得住。真不懂为什么还要等你们那帮囚犯和废物的什么蠢货。

English: <<He shrugs.>> I mean, ((no offence)).
Chinese: <<他耸肩。>>我是说,((无意冒犯))。

English: <<The High Confessor is giving orders to the agents around her; pointing with her mechanical limbs and shouting between bouts of coughing. Eventually, she notices you.>>
Chinese: <<至高忏悔者正向周围的特工下达命令;她用机械肢体指指点点,在一阵阵咳嗽之间大声喊话。最终,她注意到了你。>>

English: Ah! Prisoner... XVII, wasn't it? Our drones... have been tracking you. It seems that Vela has escaped.
Chinese: 啊!囚犯……十七号,对吧?我们的无人机……一直在追踪你。看来薇拉逃掉了。

English: I couldn't apprehend her. I failed.
Chinese: 我没能抓住她。我失败了。

English: <<A high-pitched laugh reverberates through her coffin.>> ##Nonsense. I was certain... you would be cut into tiny pieces. It's astounding you made it this far.
Chinese: <<一声尖利的笑声在棺材里回荡。>>##胡说。我当时断定……你会被切成碎片。你能走到这一步,真是不可思议。

English: But your sentence... still stands. You may yet prove your usefulness.
Chinese: 但你的刑期……依然有效。你还有机会证明你的用处。

English: I played your little game. Will you let me free?
Chinese: 我陪你玩了你的小游戏。你会放我自由吗?

English: <<The device shifts ominously towards you.>> ##Need I remind you, ((prisoner)), that your sentence remains unfulfilled?
Chinese: <<那台装置不祥地朝你挪近。>>##需要我提醒你吗,((囚犯)),你的刑期尚未服完?

English: We must... ascertain where Vela has fled to. Luckily for us, I know... just who we can ask.
Chinese: 我们必须……查明薇拉逃到了哪里。幸好,我知道……该去问谁。

English: <<She laughs to herself, but this turns into a pained series of retches. After a moment, you think she may have vomited.>> ## Excuse me.
Chinese: <<她暗自发笑,笑声却变成一阵痛苦的干呕。片刻之后,你猜她可能吐了。>>##失礼了。

English: The Oneiric Isles are home to a number of [[former Dark Star mercenaries.]]
Chinese: 梦幻群岛住着几位[[前黑星佣兵]]。

English: My superiors would rather I ((executed)) them, but... <<She is silent a moment.>> ##...They are of more use to us ((alive.)) If anyone knows where Vela went, ((they)) will.
Chinese: 我的上级巴不得我把他们((处决)),但……<<她沉默了片刻。>>##……他们((活着))对我们更有用。若有人知道薇拉去了哪,((他们))一定知道。

English: I would start with [[Jack Basalt]], a former Navy captain turned sellsword. We have already contacted him and arranged... a meeting. ##You can find him at the [[Wobbly Noggin pub]] in [[Hallow Town]], in the centre of the Oneiric Isles.
Chinese: 我会从[[杰克·巴索特]]下手,前海军上校,如今的雇佣剑客。我们已经联系过他,约定了……会面。##你可以在[[哈洛镇]]的[[摇晃酒馆]]找到他,就在梦幻群岛的中心。

English: Basalt has promised... to direct us towards his comrades, in exchange for the Polymath's Pardon. He can help you find... the others.
Chinese: 巴索特已经答应……为交换博学家的赦免,为我们指明他同伙的行踪。他能帮你找到……其余的人。

English: Got it.
Chinese: 明白了。

English: Which way is it to Hallow Town?
Chinese: 哈洛镇怎么走?

English: Follow the road south, through the [[village of Pwyll]], and cross the [[Gatebridge]]. This should get you to [[Hallowshire]].
Chinese: 沿着路往南,穿过[[普威尔村]],再越过[[关卡桥]],就能到[[哈洛郡]]。

English: You will need to acquire an [[Apostatic Union Passport]] to cross the bridge. I wish I could grant you one myself, but... we are undersupplied. ##Perhaps the locals in the [[village of Pwyll]] could help you.
Chinese: 过桥需要一份[[联盟护照]]。我本想亲自发你一份,但……我们库存不足。##[[普威尔村]]的当地人或许能帮你。

English: Why ((me)), of all your agents?
Chinese: 你那么多特工,为什么((偏偏是我))?

English: The Dark Stars... are deeply mistrustful of the Inquisition. You could say... we've had a few run-ins in the past.  ##As one of our newest and most... ((amenable)) operatives, you may have better luck than another of my agents.
Chinese: 黑星……对宗教裁判所极度不信任。可以说……我们过去有过几次冲突。##作为我们最新、最……((好说话))的行动人员之一,你或许比我其他特工运气更好。

English: Good. And be ((careful.)) These islands are on the very fringe of Apostatic Union territory. There may be worshipers, or even ((minor gods)) who have fled the Union's purges tucked away here. The only assuredly faithless place is [[Hallow Town]].
Chinese: 很好。千万((小心。))这些群岛地处叛教联盟领土的最边缘。这里可能藏着信徒,甚至是躲避联盟清洗的((小神))。唯一确保无神的地方是[[哈洛镇]]。

English: And beyond Hallowshire's borders, there is... ground even Union boots won't tread upon. ##To the east, the [[Clockwork Kingdom]] is in full-blown crisis. While the people of the [[Endless Realm]], to the west, are cursed to never die.
Chinese: 而哈洛郡边界之外,还有……联盟的靴子绝不会踏上的土地。##东边,[[发条王国]]正陷入全面危机;西边,[[无尽领域]]的人们则被诅咒永生不死。

English: My tribunal will establish a command post in this fortress, the [[Blinding Light.]] Return here to recuperate, if you wish.
Chinese: 我的法庭将在这座堡垒——[[炫光要塞]]——设立指挥所。愿意的话,可以回来这里休整。

English: Oh and, one more thing...
Chinese: 哦还有,最后一件事……

English: From now on, you'll be known as [[Confessor XVII]]. This doesn't change your crimes, or your sentence... but it sounds a little better than 'prisoner', eh?
Chinese: 从今以后,你将被称为[[忏悔者十七世]]。这不会改变你的罪行,或你的刑期……但听起来总比"囚犯"好听点,对吧?

English: Okay, I'll be going.
Chinese: 好的,我走了。

English: Farewell... Confessor.
Chinese: 再会……忏悔者。

English: I have some questions...
Chinese: 我有些问题……

English: Very well.
Chinese: 很好。

English: Welcome back, Confessor XVII.
Chinese: 欢迎回来,忏悔者十七世。

English: So you found Captain Basalt? To think that the shame of the Union Navy is... working for the Inquisition. If you had told me five years ago... <<She chuckles.>>
Chinese: 所以你找到了巴索特上校?想想看,联盟海军的耻辱……居然为宗教裁判所效力。五年前你要是跟我说……<<她轻笑。>>

English: You found the Emberian Knight? Well done, Confessor. There are few... that can match her swordplay. She'll be an asset indeed.
Chinese: 你找到了余烬骑士?干得好,忏悔者。很少有人……能在剑术上与她匹敌。她必是一大助力。

English: The Duchess has arrived, thanks to you. Even in this thing I can sense her power. Cipher radiates from that woman... like light from a neuron star.
Chinese: 多亏了你,女公爵到了。哪怕在这东西里,我也能感觉到她的力量。密文从那个女人身上辐射而出……如同神经元星的光芒。

English: You found Caxton Frost's price. Good. He has already set about... repairing this fortress. Evidently he is... quite familiar with its workings.
Chinese: 你找到了卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特的开价。很好。他已经开始……修复这座堡垒了。显然他对……它的运作相当熟悉。

English: About my mission...
Chinese: 关于我的任务……

English: What do you... want to know?
Chinese: 你……想知道什么?

English: What do I do next?
Chinese: 我接下来该做什么?

English: You must hurry to the [[Wobbly Noggin]] in [[Hallow Town]], to meet with Jack Basalt.
Chinese: 你必须赶往[[哈洛镇]]的[[摇晃酒馆]],与杰克·巴索特会面。

English: Follow the road south, through the [[village of Pwyll]], and cross the [[Gatebridge]]. This should get you to [[Hallowshire]].
Chinese: 沿着路往南,穿过[[普威尔村]],再越过[[关卡桥]],就能到[[哈洛郡]]。

English: Now that you've spoken with Basalt... you should know where to find the other three [[Dark Star mercenaries]]. Find them. Interrogate them. And bring them... back here.
Chinese: 你既然已经和巴索特谈过……就应该知道其余三名[[黑星佣兵]]的下落了。找到他们。审问他们。把他们……带回来。

English: The Emberian Knight... was Vela's second in command, and possessed combat skills... far beyond a seasoned swordsman.
Chinese: 余烬骑士……曾是薇拉的副手,战斗技艺……远超经验老到的剑客。

English: Reports place her in Hallowshire, so... ask around [[Hallow Town]].
Chinese: 据报告她在哈洛郡,所以……去[[哈洛镇]]四处打听打听。

English: Caxton Frost was an archaeologist... for the [[Clockwork Kingdom]], before he sold his intellect to the Dark Stars.
Chinese: 卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特曾是[[发条王国]]的考古学家……直到他把才智卖给了黑星。

English: We've no sign of him... but he may have returned to his King, far to the [[east.]]
Chinese: 我们没有他的消息……但他可能回到了远在[[东方]]的国王身边。

English: The Duchess... was a fearsome cipher witch. Cursed with an endless lifespan, like all her kin.
Chinese: 女公爵……是令人畏惧的密文女巫。和她所有族人一样,被诅咒拥有无尽的寿命。

English: We have reports that she has returned... to the [[Endless Realm]], in the [[west]].
Chinese: 据报告她已经回到……[[西方]]的[[无尽领域]]。

English: UNDERLANDS 1
Chinese: UNDERLANDS 1

English: UNDERLANDS 2
Chinese: UNDERLANDS 2

English: UNDERLANDS 3
Chinese: UNDERLANDS 3

English: CUTTER 1
Chinese: CUTTER 1

English: CUTTER 2
Chinese: CUTTER 2

English: CUTTER 3
Chinese: CUTTER 3

English: CRADLE 1
Chinese: CRADLE 1

English: CRADLE 2
Chinese: CRADLE 2

English: CRADLE 3
Chinese: CRADLE 3

English: Tell me about Vela Callose.
Chinese: 跟我讲讲薇拉·卡洛斯。

English: That name... commands fear and respect, across the skyrealms. Her mercenary band... the [[Dark Stars]]... have toppled tyrants, spurred uprisings... ((killed gods)).
Chinese: 那个名字……在整个天空领域令人又惧又敬。她的佣兵团……[[黑星]]……推翻过暴君,煽动过起义……((弑杀过神明))。

English: <<She takes in a strained breath.>> Even someone... as integral to the machinery of the Inquisition as I... can muster ((admiration)) for that girl, and her achievements.
Chinese: <<她艰难地吸了口气。>>哪怕是像我这样……深嵌于宗教裁判所机器之中的人……也不得不对那个女孩和她的成就心生((钦佩))。

English: <<You hear a thump from within the coffin.>> But that woman ((betrayed)) us. She could have done... even ((greater)) things. But she dragged us through the mud chasing... dark and ominous portents.
Chinese: <<你听见棺材里传来一声闷响。>>但那个女人((背叛))了我们。她本可以成就……更((伟大))的事业。却拖着我们趟过泥沼,追逐……黑暗不祥的征兆。

English: Her delusion... of making some ((heaven)) in these skyrealms... will be the end of us all. The Union Navy wants her apprehended. ##But if I... get my claws on her... she will not survive 'till the morrow.
Chinese: 她要在这天空领域建造某种((天堂))的妄想……会葬送我们所有人。联盟海军要捉拿她归案。##但若让我……把爪子搭上她……她活不过明天。

English: Tell me about the Inquisition.
Chinese: 跟我讲讲宗教裁判所。

English: We are an elite arm of the... Apostatic Union. Specialising in... espionage, intelligence and... counterworship.
Chinese: 我们是叛教联盟的……精锐之翼。专司……谍报、情报与……反崇拜。

English: As you know, to be apostatic is to... renounce one's faith. We threw off the shackles of our gods... in the [[God War]], some forty years ago.
Chinese: 如你所知,背教即是……背弃信仰。大约四十年前,我们在[[神之战]]中……挣脱了诸神的枷锁。

English: But though the flames of war... have subsided, there are still lingering threats. Wikkan covens... lurk in dark corners of the Union. Their priests... nurture shrivelled godlets and perform... foul consecrations.
Chinese: 但尽管战火……已然平息,残余的威胁仍在。维坎教团……潜伏在联盟的黑暗角落。他们的祭司……豢养干瘪的稚神,施行……污秽的祝圣。

English: Each division of the Inquisition... is known as a tribunal. One hundred operatives, plus... serving prisoners and drones. We have full authority... to enforce Union law, how we see fit.
Chinese: 宗教裁判所的每个分队……称为法庭。一百名行动人员,外加……服役囚犯和无人机。我们拥有全权……按我们认为合适的方式执行联盟法律。

English: That's all.
Chinese: 就这些。

English: Very... good.
Chinese: 很……好。

English: I wanted to ask you something.
Chinese: 我想问你点事。

English: Very well, but... <<With a shudder, the machine squats slightly. >> ## You'll have to speak up. It is most... echoey in here.
Chinese: 很好,不过……<<机器微微一颤,略略下蹲。>>##你得大点声。这里面……回音很重。

English: What's with this fortress?
Chinese: 这座堡垒是怎么回事?

English: Its name... is the [[Blinding Light]]. ##It was a God War fortress, some forty years ago. A marvel of Kardovan engineering. That giant cannon... blasted voidsteel spears through the heart of many a god.
Chinese: 它的名字……是[[炫光要塞]]。##四十年前,它是神之战堡垒。卡尔多瓦工程的奇迹。那门巨炮……曾把虚空钢长矛轰进许多神明的心脏。

English: At the height of the Dark Stars' infamy, Vela Callose procured... this fortress. Restored it... from a heap of scrap. For the past few years, since the Dark Stars mutinied against one another, Vela has been hiding here.
Chinese: 黑星恶名最盛之时,薇拉·卡洛斯弄到了……这座堡垒。把它从一堆废铁……修复了起来。自黑星自相叛变以来,这几年来薇拉一直藏身于此。

English: Believe it or not... I have been here before, long ago. It is... strange, to be back.
Chinese: 信不信由你……很久以前,我来过这里。重回旧地……感觉……很奇怪。

English: Why are you in that metal coffin?
Chinese: 你为什么待在那口金属棺材里?

English: You are not... the only member of this tribunal... to have betrayed the Apostatic Union.
Chinese: 你不是……本法庭唯一……背叛过叛教联盟的成员。

English: In my former life I committed... heinous crimes. <<She lets out a metallic sigh.>> ##Unlicenced... spellweaving. Conversing... with gods. Abetting... armed conflict. I could go on.
Chinese: 在前半生,我犯下了……滔天罪行。<<她发出一声金属摩擦般的叹息。>>##未经许可的……织咒。与神……交谈。教唆……武装冲突。我还可以继续说。

English: This iron coffin is an honour, a ((privilege)). The pain it delivers... the ((exquisite)) torment... sharpens my reason.
Chinese: 这口铁棺是荣耀,是((恩典))。它带来的痛苦……那((精妙))的折磨……磨砺着我的理智。

English: And... it was specially designed... to insulate my mind. Lest I hear the gods' cruel whispers... and forget my penance.
Chinese: 而且……它是专门设计……用来隔绝我的心智的。免得我听见诸神残忍的低语……忘掉我的赎罪。

English: If I say I saw a ((ghost)), would you think I was crazy?
Chinese: 如果我说我看见了一个((幽灵)),你会觉得我疯了吗?

English: <<The machine hesitates.>> What... did it look like?
Chinese: <<机器迟疑了。>>它……长什么样子?

English: A young woman, in a cloak.
Chinese: 一个披斗篷的年轻女人。

English: Very... spectral.
Chinese: 非常……虚幻。

English: <<The High Confessor is silent for a moment. When she speaks, she speaks slowly.>> ##Ghosts are traces... of trauma. Remnants of human suffering, lingering in the air...
Chinese: <<至高忏悔者沉默了片刻。再开口时,她的语速很慢。>>##幽灵是创伤的……痕迹。人类苦痛的残余,在空气中徘徊……

English: ...and the Oneiric Isles have known much hardship. The Endless Realm in particular... is infested with spirits.
Chinese: ……而梦幻群岛历经苦难。尤其是无尽领域……更是闹鬼成灾。

English: I would not... pay any heed... to the words of apparitions. They are tormented things and will... lead you astray.
Chinese: 我劝你……别把鬼魂的话……当回事。它们是受折磨的东西,会……把你引入歧途。

English: There's a ((god)) in this fortress.
Chinese: 这座堡垒里有一个((神))。

English: god1
Chinese: god1

English: god2
Chinese: god2

English: god3
Chinese: god3

English: That's all.
Chinese: 就这些。

English: Very well, Confessor.
Chinese: 好的,忏悔者。

English: I'll be going.
Chinese: 我走了。

English: <<The machine nods jerkily, which you take to mean goodbye.>>
Chinese: <<机器僵硬地点了点头,你把这当作道别。>>

English: My... haven't you been busy? All of the former Dark Stars... have returned. ##<<She cackles and coughs.>> Just like... old times.
Chinese: 哎呀……你可真够忙的?所有前黑星成员……都归队了。##<<她咯咯笑着,又咳嗽起来。>>就像……当年一样。

English: Together we've conceived... a plan. According to Orlaith, Vela has fled to the [[Underlands]], and what's more, she knows ((where)). ##You will take these Dark Star criminals as your... companions. You will pursue Vela. You will ((not)) fail.
Chinese: 我们一起想出了……一个计划。据奥莱丝说,薇拉已经逃往[[地下之地]],而且她知道((确切位置))。##你将带着这些黑星罪犯作为你的……同伴。你将追捕薇拉。你((不许))失败。

English: I'll not go to the Underlands! That's a death sentence.
Chinese: 我不去地下之地!那等于判我死刑。

English: <<She jabs a mechanical limb in your direction.>> And so what if it ((is))? Must I remind you... that you are still my ((prisoner))? ##You have explored these islands as ((penance)) for your crimes. And if I send you to your certain demise, you will do so gladly.
Chinese: <<她把一根机械肢体戳向你。>>就算是((又如何))?需要我提醒你吗……你还是我的((囚犯))?##你探索这些岛屿,是为罪行((赎罪))。若我送你去赴死,你也当欣然前往。

English: What's down there, exactly?
Chinese: 那下面到底有什么?

English: Centuries ago, the Emberians... built an empire of metal and magic, in defiance of the gods. It stretched across the world's surface... and humanity ((prospered)). <<She spits the word.>>
Chinese: 数百年前,余烬人……建立了金属与魔法的帝国,公然藐视诸神。它横跨世界地表……人类((繁盛))一时。<<她啐出这个词。>>

English: But four hundred years ago... the [[World Rend]] blasted that empire to dust. Only the Skyrealms... survived. All that's left down there... are cursed ruins, haunted by ghosts... and patrolled by mechanical horrors.
Chinese: 但四百年前……[[世界撕裂]]把那个帝国炸成了尘埃。只有天空领域……幸存下来。下面剩下的……只有被诅咒的废墟,游荡着幽灵……还有机械恐怖在巡逻。

English: The very air is poisoned... with a thick miasma. Traversing that place will be.. difficult. But I have the utmost faith that you will die nobly for our cause. You may even... ((succeed)).
Chinese: 那里的空气本身就弥漫着……浓重的毒瘴。穿越那片地方会很……艰难。但我满怀信心,你会为我们的崇高事业体面地死去。你甚至可能……((成功))。

English: Okay. So how will we do it?
Chinese: 好吧。那我们怎么下去?

English: Caxton Frost has finished repairing the [[Blinding Light]]. We can launch a small [[cutter airship]]... on an expedition to the Underlands.
Chinese: 卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特已经修好了[[炫光要塞]]。我们可以发射一艘小型[[快艇飞艇]]……远征地下之地。

English: But first... I will let you do the honours... of [[activating the Blinding Light]]. ##Go to the main control panel... and set the alert... for battle stations.
Chinese: 但首先……我要让你来完成[[启动炫光要塞]]的……荣耀使命。##去主控台……把警报……设为战斗状态。

English: What do we have here? Another wretched soul caught in the Inquisition's web, no doubt.
Chinese: 瞧瞧这是谁?不用猜,又一个被宗教裁判所罗网缠住的可怜灵魂。

English: Tell me, has your High Confessor sent you off to die?
Chinese: 告诉我,你的至高忏悔者是不是把你派来送死了?

English: Yes.
Chinese: 是。

English: <<A melancholic smile spreads across her lips.>>##She can be terribly cruel, can't she?
Chinese: <<一抹忧郁的笑容在她唇边漾开。>>##她有时冷酷得可怕,不是吗?

English: No.
Chinese: 不是。

English: So you're loyal to that absurd institution? You really are a lost cause.
Chinese: 所以你对那个荒唐机构忠心耿耿?你可真是无可救药。

English: Before long, those Inquisition bastards will have locked up half the Skyrealms. And for what? Praying to a family deity? Having a little ((hope))?
Chinese: 用不了多久,宗教裁判所那帮混蛋就会把半个天空领域都关起来。为了什么?向家宅神明祈祷?怀有的一点((希望))?

English: Are you... a ghost?
Chinese: 你是……幽灵吗?

English: <<She smiles, gesturing at herself.>> Are you ((shocked)) by a little apparition?
Chinese: <<她微笑着,指了指自己。>>一个小小幽灵就把你((吓着))了?

English: <<Her gentle laugh seems to echo around you.>> My, my, you won't get far if that's the case.
Chinese: <<她温柔的笑声似乎在你周围回荡。>>哎呀呀,这样的话你可走不了多远。

English: <<She gazes into the distance.>>
Chinese: <<她凝望远方。>>

English: <<She gazes into the distance.>> ##Well stranger, you'd best watch yourself out there. Mark my words, something's brewing on these islands. The stage is set, the curtains drawn; and the performance is set to bring the house ((down)).
Chinese: <<她凝望远方。>>##好了,陌生人,在外面你最好多加小心。记住我的话,这些岛屿上正酝酿着什么。舞台已经搭好,幕布已经拉开;这场演出注定((全场轰动))。

English: <<She smirks at you.>> And something tells me you have your own role to play.
Chinese: <<她朝你狡黠一笑。>>而且我有种预感,你也有自己的戏份要演。

English: See that looming fortress? It's struck fear into the hearts of many who were braver and stronger than you, stranger.
Chinese: 看见那座阴森耸立的堡垒了吗?多少比你勇敢、比你强大的人,都曾在它面前心生恐惧,陌生人。

English: It was made in the God War, so the apostatics named it the [[Blinding Light]] to ridicule the gods they planned to butcher.
Chinese: 它造于神之战,背教者给它起名[[炫光要塞]],以此嘲讽他们打算宰杀的诸神。

English: Ironic, that it should fall into the hands of someone so ((blinded)) by ambition and zeal; for Vela has claimed it in pursuit of her own twisted heaven, and the Blinding Light now turns its guns towards the faithless souls who made it.
Chinese: 讽刺的是,它竟落入一个被野心和狂热((蒙蔽))的人手中;薇拉为了她那扭曲的天堂占有了它,如今炫光要塞的炮口调转向了当初造出它的无信之人。

English: <<Her spectral eyes glisten.>> Tell me, stranger. If a hated enemy stood between you and your most cherished ideal, would you strike them down? Would you have the ((arrogance)) to take a life in pursuit of your fantasy?
Chinese: <<她的幽灵之眼闪着微光。>>告诉我,陌生人。如果你憎恨的敌人挡在你最珍视的理想面前,你会杀掉他们吗?你可敢怀那份((傲慢)),为追逐幻想而取人性命?

English: Yes, I would kill for my beliefs.
Chinese: 是,我愿意为信念杀人。

English: At least you're the honest sort; and you're hardly alone. The Skyrealms are stained with the blood of those who stood on the wrong side of history. Even the ((gods)) proved fallible, in the end.
Chinese: 至少你算诚实的;何况你绝非孤例。天空领域浸透了站在历史错误一边者的血。到头来,连((诸神))也难免犯错。

English: Never.
Chinese: 绝不。

English: <<She grins.>> So you're a butcher ((and)) a liar? ##Don't think I haven't been watching you, stranger. Moments after the Inquisition shoved you out of their prison, you've been killing Vela's comrades with nary a hint of remorse.
Chinese: <<她咧嘴一笑。>>所以你既是屠夫((又是))骗子?##别以为我没在看着你,陌生人。宗教裁判所刚把你从牢里踹出来,你就不带一丝悔意地屠杀薇拉的同伴。

English: <<She smiles weakly.>> A kind heart is a rarity, it seems; but so far you're true to your word.
Chinese: <<她浅浅一笑。>>善良的心看来真是稀有;不过到目前为止,你还算言而有信。

English: Still, I fear that in a world like this, such a heart will only see you dead in a gutter by the sword of someone far less scrupulous.
Chinese: 尽管如此,我担心在这样的世界里,这样一颗心只会让你死在水沟里,倒在某个远不如你讲究之人的剑下。

English: Still, you've piqued my curiosity, stranger. I'll have my eye on you.
Chinese: 不过,你勾起了我的好奇,陌生人。我会盯着你的。

English: Ah, do you feel that? The Blinding Light takes to the skies once again!
Chinese: 啊,你感觉到了吗?炫光要塞再度升空!

English: You never said this was an airship.
Chinese: 你从没说过这是一艘飞艇。

English: <<She scoffs.>> Have you not... seen the grand painting, or its many reproductions: ((The Blinding Light Impales a Horror))? Or heard the numerous songs and stories, embellished as they may be? ##I cannot be blamed... for your ignorance.
Chinese: <<她嗤笑。>>你没……见过那幅宏伟的画作,或者它的众多复制品:((《炫光要塞刺穿恐怖》))?也没听过那些添油加醋的歌谣和传说?##你的无知……可怪不到我头上。

English: Can't we just fly this whole ship after Vela?
Chinese: 我们不能开着这整艘船去追薇拉吗?

English: This flying fortress is too large... to make the descent. The storms that permanently rage above the Underlands would tear it to shreds.
Chinese: 这座飞行堡垒太大……无法下降。地下之地上空永不停歇的风暴会把它撕成碎片。

English: But we can launch a small cutter vessel with a reinforced hull... that may survive the journey. The tribunal can monitor your progress from the safety of the skies.
Chinese: 但我们可以发射一艘加固船体的小型快艇……或许能挺过这段航程。法庭会在安全的高空监视你的进展。

English: So what next?
Chinese: 那接下来呢?

English: You and the former Dark Stars will assemble into a counterworship strike force... and pursue Vela. ##Your mission is... as follows.
Chinese: 你和前黑星成员将组成一支反崇拜突击队……追击薇拉。##你的任务……如下。

English: You will make your way to the [[hangar]] of the Blinding Light, where there is a small [[cutter airship]] ready to descend to the Underlands.
Chinese: 你要先前往炫光要塞的[[机库]],那里有一艘小型[[快艇飞艇]],随时可以下潜到地下之地。

English: Jack Basalt will pilot the craft, while the Duchess' magic... will shield it from the unrelenting chaos of the understorms. Caxton Frost... will disarm whatever ancient security systems you find on the surface.
Chinese: 杰克·巴索特将驾驶这艘船,女公爵的魔法……将护它抵御地底风暴的无情肆虐。卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特……会拆除你们在地表遇到的任何古老安保系统。

English: Once you land, Orlaith will guide the way... to the [[Cradle]]. Exactly what the Cradle is, we don't know; but Vela... thinks it can rewrite the very fabric of ((reality)). ##Needless to say, she must be ((stopped)).
Chinese: 着陆之后,奥莱丝会为你们引路……前往[[摇篮]]。谁也说不清摇篮到底是什么;但薇拉……认为它能改写((现实))的根基。##不用说,必须((阻止))她。

English: <<She pauses. A ghastly rattle issues from within her workings: is it a sigh? She sounds almost... moved.>> Listen, Confessor.  If it were up to me, we'd have a whole ((naval fleet)) hurtling down there. But the Union Navy doesn't want to hear it. They think this coffin they stuffed me in... has clouded my reason.
Chinese: <<她顿了顿。她的机关内部传出骇人的咔嗒声:那是叹息吗?她的声音听起来几乎……动情。>>听着,忏悔者。若由我做主,我们会派一整支((舰队))冲下去。但联盟海军听不进去。他们认为他们塞我的这口棺材……已经蒙蔽了我的理智。

English: I have the authority to send only the most ((expendable)) of my tribunal. ##<<She points a mechanical limb in your direction.>> But, loath as I am to admit it, you've proven yourself just as capable... as any operative under my command.
Chinese: 我只有权派出法庭里最((可牺牲))的人员。##<<她把一根机械肢体指向你。>>但,尽管我很不情愿承认,你已经证明了自己的能干……不输我麾下任何一名行动人员。

English: So it falls solely on ((your)) team to stop Vela at any cost. Remember... that she meddles with forces beyond our comprehension, and threatens the stability of not just the Apostatic Union... but the whole of the skyrealms.
Chinese: 所以,不惜一切代价拦住薇拉,这重任就落在((你))的队伍肩上。记住……她在摆弄远超我们理解的力量,威胁的不仅是叛教联盟的稳定……更是整个天空领域。

English: Is your mission clear, Confessor XVII?
Chinese: 任务清楚了吗,忏悔者十七世?

English: All clear. I'm ready.
Chinese: 完全清楚。我准备好了。

English: Good. Make your way to [[the hangar]] to depart.
Chinese: 很好。前往[[机库]]出发吧。

English: I have questions.
Chinese: 我有问题。

English: Very well, but make them quick. We are ready... to depart.
Chinese: 很好,但要快。我们随时……可以出发了。

English: Do we know what Vela's doing, down there?
Chinese: 我们知道薇拉在下面干什么吗?

English: Long ago, before the Dark Star mutiny... Vela found a map to some ancient thing. Powerful and dangerous beyond belief. The Emberians called it... the [[Cradle]].
Chinese: 很久以前,黑星叛变之前……薇拉找到了一张通往某个远古之物的地图。它的强大与危险超乎想象。余烬人称之为……[[摇篮]]。

English: Orlaith was with Vela when she discovered the map. She thinks... she can get you there. For all our sakes... she'd better be right.
Chinese: 奥莱丝发现那张地图时正与薇拉同行。她认为……她能带你们到那里。为了我们所有人……她最好没说错。

English: Because while we know next to nothing about this Cradle, what we ((do)) know... chills me to the bone. If our intel is correct, and the thing ((works)), Vela could rewrite the very language of cipher... that ties reality together.
Chinese: 因为我们对这摇篮几乎一无所知,但仅有的((已知))……已让我胆寒。若情报无误,而这东西((真的有效)),薇拉就能改写维系现实的密文语言本身……

English: That means she could unravel existence itself. She could ((end the world)) as we know it.
Chinese: 那意味着她能拆解存在本身。她能((终结世界)),终结我们所知的一切。

English: What dangers can we expect in the Underlands?
Chinese: 在地下之地我们会遇到什么危险?

English: I won't lie to you... Confessor XVII. There are many. ##Your first challenge will be... the understorms. Since the World Rend, a raging tempest has engulfed the surface. To get through unscathed... will take all of the Duchess' cipher craft.
Chinese: 我不骗你……忏悔者十七世。危险很多。##第一道难关就是……地底风暴。自世界撕裂以来,一场狂暴的风暴就笼罩着地表。要毫发无损地穿过……得靠女公爵全部的密文技艺。

English: As soon as you land, you will be cursed... by the thick miasma that lingers in the ruins. Unless you can find some way to counteract it, you will suffer... weakness of mind and body.
Chinese: 一着陆,你们就会被废墟中弥漫的浓重毒瘴……侵蚀。除非能找到办法抵御,否则你们将饱受……身心衰弱之苦。

English: And then there are the... dangers that stalk the rubble. Those few who have returned from the underlands alive have told of... soldiers made of metal, who never tire in their patrols... and vengeful wraiths who can cut a person in twain.
Chinese: 此外还有……在瓦砾间潜行的危险。寥寥几个从地下之地活着回来的人说,那里有……永不疲倦巡逻的金属士兵……还有能把人劈成两半的复仇怨灵。

English: Can we trust the loyalty of the team?
Chinese: 我们能信任队伍的忠诚吗?

English: It is true... that while your comrades are Dark Stars no longer, they may feel conflicting loyalties... when faced with their former leader.
Chinese: 确实……你的同伴虽已不再是黑星,但面对昔日首领时,他们或许会忠诚动摇……

English: And as many who meet Vela are swayed... by her radical ideals, I cannot even be sure of your ((own)) loyalties, Confessor.
Chinese: 而见过薇拉的人,许多都被……她的激进理想动摇,所以我连你((自己))的忠诚都不敢担保,忏悔者。

English: But I know Vela. These past few years... she has been watching her back with a frenzied paranoia. She will not trust... anyone meddling with her plans.
Chinese: 但我了解薇拉。这些年……她一直以疯狂的偏执提防着身后。她不会信任……任何干扰她计划的人。

English: Should any of you prove traitorous to the Inquisition... I know it is ((Vela)) who will cut you down.
Chinese: 若你们中有谁被证明背叛了宗教裁判所……我知道,动手砍倒你们的会是((薇拉))。

English: Tell me again about our Underlands mission.
Chinese: 再跟我说说我们的地下之地任务。

English: [[Hallowshire]] fields used to be sown with Wikkan seed; for their deities, though diminished, could ensure a good harvest. The god-contracts were modest; the blood-price was equitable.
Chinese: [[哈洛郡]]的田地曾播下维坎的种子;因为他们的神明虽已衰微,却能保佑丰收。神之契约是温和的;血价也是公道的。

English: Of course, the Apostatic Union sniffed it out eventually. They sent over that [[Polymath]] and her retinue to stamp out any smouldering divinity, and now the common folk starve; their fields barren and desolate.
Chinese: 当然,叛教联盟最终还是嗅到了苗头。他们派来那位[[博学家]]和她的随从,铲除一切余烬未熄的神圣,如今平民忍饥挨饿;田地荒芜贫瘠。

English: The Union claim it's in the name of ((reason)) and ((progress.)) <<She lets out a discordant sigh>>. ## I admit, those old Wikkan contracts can be... deceitful. Many don't realise the weight of their signature until the curse sets in...
Chinese: 联盟声称这是为((理性))与((进步))之名。<<她发出一声刺耳的叹息>>。##我承认,那些古老的维坎契约可能……充满欺骗。许多人直到诅咒降临,才意识到自己签下的分量……

English: But the Union would smother the Skyrealms in a tangle of bureaucracy, until we worship naught but deadlines and shipping manifests. Their only saving grace is their honesty; for at least the people ((know)) they are trampled upon.
Chinese: 但联盟会用盘根错节的官僚体系窒息整个天空领域,直到我们只崇拜死线和货运清单。他们唯一可取之处是诚实;因为至少民众((知道))自己在被践踏。

English: So what about ((you)), stranger? Would you rather be enveloped in a sweetened lie, blissful in your ignorance; or would you choose the bitter ((truth))?
Chinese: 那么((你))呢,陌生人?你宁愿被裹进加糖的谎言里,在无知中飘飘欲仙;还是选择苦涩的((真相))?

English: Everyone deserves to know the truth.
Chinese: 每个人都有权知道真相。

English: <<She smiles wryly.>> But could we ever ((know)) the truth, for certain? Perhaps we are all but actors in another's dream, destined to be forgotten with the morning light...
Chinese: <<她苦笑。>>可我们真的能((知道))真相吗?或许我们都不过是别人梦中的戏子,注定随晨光一同被遗忘……

English: If the Union discovered it was thus, and wrote it in all their books; would we be enlightened? Or just more lost?
Chinese: 若联盟发现真相如此,并写进他们所有的书里;我们会因此开悟吗?还是更加迷失?

English: If a false belief brings joy, let it be.
Chinese: 若虚假的信念能带来欢愉,就随它去吧。

English: <<She smiles warmly.>> Said with compassion, stranger. ##I would agree wholeheartedly, if I didn't know the darker side of such tolerance.
Chinese: <<她温暖地笑了。>>说得很有同情心,陌生人。##若不是深知这种宽容的阴暗面,我会全心全意赞同你。

English: For when fantasies collide, the bloodshed is assuredly real. The God War is testament to that.
Chinese: 因为当幻想彼此碰撞,流淌的鲜血可千真万确。神之战便是明证。

English: The idea of truth is a lie; we are all deluded.
Chinese: 真相这个概念本身就是谎言;我们都在自欺。

English: <<She smiles.>> My mother once told me: there are as many worlds as people in it. ##I think she would have liked you, stranger.
Chinese: <<她笑了。>>我母亲曾对我说:世上的人有多少,世界就有多少个。##我想她会喜欢你的,陌生人。

English: Can you ((smell)) it, stranger - that rancid stench on the wind? The [[Endless Realm]] is trapped in a perpetual decay; for everything here rots, but nothing ever dies.
Chinese: 你能((闻))到吗,陌生人——风中那股腐臭?[[无尽领域]]困在永恒的腐烂里;这里的一切都在朽坏,却没有任何东西真正死去。

English: Its people huddle in underground tomb-cities, sealing their frail bodies from the outside while they indulge in nostalgic reverie. They have achieved what many mortals lust for; a life unending.
Chinese: 它的人民蜷缩在地下的陵墓之城中,把脆弱的身体与外界隔绝,沉溺于怀旧的迷梦。他们得到了许多凡人梦寐以求的东西:永无止境的生命。

English: But is such a wretched existence preferable to death? Tell me, stranger; if those Union scholars are right, and there is nought after life but a dreamless sleep - does that nothingness negate what came before? Is our existence rendered pointless by impending oblivion?
Chinese: 可这样悲惨的存在比死亡更好吗?告诉我,陌生人;若联盟那些学者是对的,死后不过是一场无梦的沉睡——那片虚无会否定此前的一切吗?迫近的遗忘会让我们的人生失去意义吗?

English: It's true. Death makes our lives meaningless.
Chinese: 没错。死亡让我们的生命毫无意义。

English: <<She chuckles.>> Hearing ((you)) say it, it sounds rather morbid.
Chinese: <<她轻笑。>>从((你))嘴里说出来,听着还挺病态的。

English: <<She gestures around herself.>> So what's all ((this)), then? The collective achievement of us mortals, the ((wonders)) of civilisation? Is it all just some shared delusion; a denial of our inherent futility?
Chinese: <<她指了指四周。>>那((这))一切又算什么?我们凡人的集体成就,文明的((奇观))?难道全都是某种共享的妄想;对我们固有徒劳的否认?

English: <<She grins.>> You know, don't answer that. Even as a spirit it gives me the chills.
Chinese: <<她咧嘴一笑。>>算了,别回答。哪怕成了幽灵,这也让我发毛。

English: Brevity is beautiful. Eternal life would be torture.
Chinese: 生命短暂才美。永生是折磨。

English: <<She nods.>> Many of the Endless would share your sentiment, after being prisoners of their bodies for so long. It is said that even those Endless who are cut to pieces are still... conscious.
Chinese: <<她点头。>>许多无尽者会同意你的看法,毕竟他们被囚禁在自己的身体里太久了。据说就连被碎尸万段的无尽者仍然……有意识。

English: I have no doubt that, after enough time, we'd all beg for nothingness.
Chinese: 我毫不怀疑,时间够久,我们全都会乞求虚无。

English: It's pointless to think about it.
Chinese: 想这些毫无意义。

English: <<She smiles.>> Said with the wisdom of a thousand lifetimes.
Chinese: <<她笑了。>>说得像活了千辈子的人一样通透。

English: No matter what spells we weave or bargains we strike, the end comes for us all, eventually.
Chinese: 无论我们织下什么咒语、达成什么交易,终点终会降临于所有人。

English: Change is a force that sweeps through the Skyrealms unhindered; none can escape it. The Wikkans tried to resist and were ground to dust. But for some, the maelstrom of change is like wind for their sails.
Chinese: 变革是一股席卷天空领域、无人可挡的力量;谁也逃不掉。维坎教团试图抵抗,结果被碾成齑粉。但对某些人而言,变革的漩涡恰似鼓满船帆的劲风。

English: In the aftermath of the God War, the Skyrealms had a chance to choose their own masters. But here in the [[Clockwork Kingdom]] that was not enough. Their cipher scribes and machinists committed to ((build)) their monarch from metal and magic.
Chinese: 神之战结束后,天空领域本有机会选择自己的主人。但在[[发条王国]],这还不够。他们的密文誊写师和机械师决意用金属与魔法((铸造))自己的君主。

English: It was to be a realm where any common labourer could draw on the power of a god; where every belly would be full. But to embrace such drastic change is also to roll the dice of fate, and the denizens here have found their luck wanting.
Chinese: 那本该是一个普通劳工也能借用神之力量的国度;一个家家户户都能吃饱的国度。但拥抱如此剧烈的变革,也是在掷命运的骰子,而这里的居民发现自己的运气不济。

English: So what do you think, stranger? Though their people lie rotting in the barren fields, was it noble of them to ((try)) to reach for the heavens, despite the risks?
Chinese: 你怎么看,陌生人?尽管他们的子民烂在贫瘠的田野里,他们((尝试))不顾风险去触碰苍穹,这算不算高尚?

English: We should always strive to be better, no matter the cost.
Chinese: 我们应当永远力求变得更好,无论代价如何。

English: <<She nods.>> A noble sentiment, for sure. But the road to radical change is slippery with blood, and reality is never as sweet as our dreams...
Chinese: <<她点头。>>高尚的情操,这没错。但激进变革的路上血迹斑斑、步步惊心,而现实从来不像我们的梦那般甜蜜……

English: Idealism is well and good, but not when lives are at stake.
Chinese: 理想主义固然好,但性命攸关时就不是了。

English: <<She nods.>> A pragmatic answer. But a ruler would soon learn that their hands will never be clean from blood; and doing nothing is still a decision.\t
Chinese: <<她点头。>>务实的回答。但统治者很快就会明白,他们的双手永远洗不净血污;而无所作为同样是一种抉择。

English: I'd rather leave such dilemmas to the ruling classes.
Chinese: 这种两难难题,我宁愿留给统治阶层。

English: <<She nods.>> The burden of choice is a heavy one, and there is never a correct path. I don't blame you for feeling like this, stranger.
Chinese: <<她点头。>>抉择的重担沉重无比,从来没有正确的道路。你有这种想法,我不怪你,陌生人。

English: Vela spent countless nights here, hunched at her desk by the light of a candle. While the rest of her crew slept, she would pore over sky-charts and scour old tomes for shreds of arcane knowledge.
Chinese: 薇拉曾在这里度过无数个夜晚,就着一支烛光伏案而坐。船员们酣睡时,她会钻研天航图,翻遍古老的典籍,寻找秘奥知识的残章片语。

English: Back then - when I was flesh and blood - I thought she was driven by a pure desire to carve out a better world. But in time I came to think of her as little more than a frightened girl, trying to fix something ((broken)) inside herself.
Chinese: 那时——我还有血有肉的时候——我以为驱使她的是开创更美好世界的纯粹愿望。但随着时间推移,我渐渐觉得她不过是个惊恐的女孩,试图修补自己内心((破碎))的东西。

English: For there is a thorn in Vela's heart that she cannot remove. Sometimes its maddening scratch pushes her to greatness; other times, it twists her into cruelty and barbarism.
Chinese: 因为薇拉心里有一根拔不掉的刺。有时它疯狂的搔挠推着她走向伟大;有时,它把她扭成残忍与蛮横。

English: <<The ghost looks into your eyes.>> Listen, stranger. Whether you wish it or not, you ((will)) cross paths with Vela; I see it clear as day. But what will happen next is a tangle of infinite possibilities; a dark void that swallows any attempt at foresight.
Chinese: <<幽灵直视你的眼睛。>>听着,陌生人。无论你愿不愿意,你((终将))与薇拉相遇;这一点我看得一清二楚。但接下来会发生什么,是无限可能的乱麻;是一片吞噬任何预见尝试的黑暗虚空。

English: If you wish to understand the woman your fate is bound to, seek an old manor that drifts on the [[north-eastern edge of Hallowshire]]. I will meet you there.
Chinese: 若你想了解与你命运纠缠的这个人,去寻一座漂浮在[[哈洛郡东北边缘]]的古老庄园。我会在那里见你。

English: For many years this manor gleamed with opulence. Wikkan blood paid for its walls and the spoils of battle filled its rooms; as it belonged to [[Admiral Callose]], who rose to prominence in the God War.
Chinese: 多年来,这座庄园金碧辉煌。维坎人的血买下了它的墙壁,战利品堆满了它的房间;因为它属于[[卡洛斯上将]]——在神之战中声名鹊起的人物。

English: Yet happiness bloomed here. With her sister Isabet, Vela's formative years were joyful; as they played under the watchful eye of their mother.
Chinese: 然而幸福也曾在此绽放。与妹妹伊莎贝特相伴,薇拉的成长岁月是快乐的;她们在母亲的看护下嬉戏玩耍。

English: But our folly is to assume our privilege, once attained, will endure. A single spilled candle can raze a timber-built town to the ground - something similar happened here.
Chinese: 可我们的愚昧就在于,以为既得的特权会永远长存。一支打翻的蜡烛就能把一座木造城镇夷为平地——类似的事情就发生在这里。

English: That's tragic.
Chinese: 真是悲剧。

English: For Vela, her world came crashing down. In later life she would recognise the price others paid for her privilege; but to that child? She had simply lost her home, her ((family)).
Chinese: 对薇拉而言,她的世界轰然崩塌。长大后的她会明白,别人为她的特权付出了怎样的代价;但对那个孩子来说?她只是失去了家,失去了((家人))。

English: Good riddance.
Chinese: 死得好。

English: Was this place a stolen bounty? Or a child's cherished home? In truth it was both. Morality is not some equation with a right answer; it is messy, murky...
Chinese: 这地方是被窃取的不义之财?还是孩子珍爱的家园?实际上,两者皆是。道德不是一道有标准答案的方程;它混乱,浑浊……

English: I don't care for old stories.
Chinese: 我对老故事不感兴趣。

English: So that's what the world is to you, stranger? Just an old story with forgettable characters? <<She smiles.>> ##Well, I hope I'm not boring you.
Chinese: 在你眼里世界就是这样吗,陌生人?不过是个人物很快被遗忘的老故事?<<她笑了。>>##好吧,希望我没让你觉得无聊。

English: Vela and her father were away when this manor was ablaze. But Vela's sister Isabet, and their mother, were burned alive.
Chinese: 庄园燃起大火时,薇拉和她父亲都不在。但薇拉的妹妹伊莎贝特和她们的母亲被活活烧死。

English: Isabet was a prodigy. From a young age, Vela and Isabet would stow away to explore Emberian ruins, much to their father's ire. Isabet could pull apart that ancient wreckage and put it back together, working as if it were new.
Chinese: 伊莎贝特是个天才。从小,薇拉和伊莎贝特就常常偷偷溜出去探索余烬遗迹,令她们的父亲大为光火。伊莎贝特能把那些古老的残骸拆开再装回去,运转如新。

English: Had Isabet lived, she would have thrived. I can see her now, as one of the most respected archaeologists of the skyrealms.
Chinese: 若伊莎贝特还活着,她必成大器。我现在仿佛还能看见她,成为天空领域最受尊敬的考古学家之一。

English: Vela never recovered from Isabet's death. In every arcane tome, every forbidden volume, Vela would search for some way to bring Isabet back. But though the Skyrealms teems with creatures who make a mockery of life - ((myself)) included - Vela never found an answer.
Chinese: 薇拉始终没能从伊莎贝特的死中走出来。每一本秘奥典籍、每一卷禁书,薇拉都要翻找,寻找让伊莎贝特复活的办法。但尽管天空领域遍布嘲弄生死的生物——包括((我))在内——薇拉始终没有找到答案。

English: For the grammar of cipher magic contains strict rules. The [[Mortal Principle]], long studied but little understood, prevents a body from being revived. People can be plucked from the jaws of death, or their lives extended unnaturally; but for the charred remains of Isabet, nothing can be done.
Chinese: 因为密文魔法的语法包含严格的规则。[[凡人法则]]研究已久却知之甚少,它禁止躯体复活。人可以从死亡边缘被拉回,生命可以被非自然地延长;但对于伊莎贝特焦黑的遗骸,无能为力。

English: Could Isabet be revived as an Endless?
Chinese: 伊莎贝特能以无尽者的身份复活吗?

English: The ritual that created the Endless ((has)) been repeated, on rare occasions... but it requires a ((living)) subject.
Chinese: 造就无尽者的仪式((确实))曾在极罕见的场合被重复过……但它需要((活着的))对象。

English: The same applies for ghosts like myself. We are imprints of trauma; an echo of a mind created in a single, terrifying moment. But without a living body? Not possible.
Chinese: 像我这样的幽灵也是如此。我们是创伤的印痕;是某个可怕的瞬间在心智中激起的回声。但没有活的躯体?不可能。

English: Couldn't a god revive her?
Chinese: 神不能让她复活吗?

English: Vela thought as much. She even went as far to capture one, imprisoning the poor thing with chains of voidsteel in the Blinding Light.
Chinese: 薇拉也是这么想的。她甚至走到了捕获一位神的地步,用虚空钢锁链把那可怜的小东西囚禁在炫光要塞。

English: But its powers, though incredible, were limited. It could only save a single living soul from near-death. Were you to give it a corpse, it could not create life from nothing.
Chinese: 但它的力量虽然惊人,却有极限。它只能把一个活着的灵魂从死亡边缘救回。你若给它一具尸体,它无法凭空创造生命。

English: So ((this)) is the thorn in Vela's heart.
Chinese: 所以((这就是))薇拉心中的那根刺。

English: <<She nods slowly.>> I think it was Isabet's loss that drove Vela to quit the Union Navy. With her father an admiral, she could have risen to the very top; but she just... didn't see the point of it.
Chinese: <<她缓缓点头。>>我想正是失去伊莎贝特,才让薇拉退出了联盟海军。父亲身为上将,她本可一路升到顶端;但她就是……看不到那有什么意义。

English: So she took her father's dream and inverted it. The Dark Stars were born; its black star motif a cynical mockery of the symbol of the Apostatic Union.
Chinese: 于是她把父亲的梦想反转过来。黑星佣兵团就此诞生;那黑色五角星的徽记,是对叛教联盟标志的愤世嘲弄。

English: <<She smiles.>> But we've had enough storytelling for one day, eh? There is an island with an [[Airship Cove]] on the [[western-edge of the Endless Realm]]; meet me there when you're ready, and I'll continue my tale.
Chinese: <<她笑了。>>不过今天的故事就讲到这儿吧?[[无尽领域西缘]]有一座带[[飞艇湾]]的岛;你准备好就到那里找我,我会继续讲下去。

English: This is where it all started; the mercenary outfit known as the Dark Stars. ##Vela, Jack Basalt and Orlaith. Just the three of them in a cave with a rickety sloop, barely skyworthy.
Chinese: 这就是一切开始的地方;人称黑星的佣兵组织。##薇拉、杰克·巴索特和奥莱丝。就他们三个,窝在一个山洞里,守着一艘摇摇晃晃的小艇,勉强能飞。

English: On one of their first jobs they found ((me)). Or rather, the ((real)) me, before I looked like a rubbish painting. <<She grins.>> ##The three of them damn near killed me.
Chinese: 在最早的几次活计中,他们找到了((我))。或者说是((真正的))我,在我看起来像一幅烂画之前。<<她咧嘴笑。>>##那三个家伙差点要了我的命。

English: So, wait, you ((fought)) Vela?
Chinese: 等等,所以你((打过))薇拉?

English: That's right, stranger. They'd been hired by a Riovan noble to round up Wikkans in Hallowshire, back before the Union was here in full force.
Chinese: 没错,陌生人。里奥瓦的一位贵族雇他们在哈洛郡围捕维坎人,那时联盟还没在此重兵驻扎。

English: So I woke up one morning with Orlaith's sword at my throat. In her full Emberian armour, it was quite the shock. Though, not as much of the shock I gave ((her)) - a bolt of pure electricity, surging through all that metal...
Chinese: 于是一天清晨我醒来,奥莱丝的剑就架在我喉咙上。她那身余烬全身铠甲,着实吓了我一跳。不过,我给((她))的惊吓更大——一道纯粹的闪电,顺着那一身金属畅行无阻……

English: And so we fought; me and my godlet, versus the three of them. I almost escaped, but... seeing Vela fight is something ((else)).
Chinese: 于是我们打了起来;我和我的稚神,对阵他们三个。我差点就逃掉了,但……薇拉的战斗方式实在((与众不同))。

English: Usually I can scry what someone plans to do, but Vela's thoughts are bristling with possibilities. Before I knew it she was behind me with a dagger to my neck.
Chinese: 平时我能窥探别人打算做什么,但薇拉的思绪中挤满了可能性。等我回过神来,她已经绕到我身后,匕首抵住了我的脖颈。

English: Get to the point, ghost.
Chinese: 说重点,幽灵。

English: <<She grins.>> As you wish. ##Vela, Orlaith and Basalt assaulted me, one morning. I put up a good fight, but... I ended up with Vela's dagger against my throat.
Chinese: <<她咧嘴笑。>>如你所愿。##一天清晨,薇拉、奥莱丝和巴索特突袭了我。我奋起反击,表现不俗,但……最后薇拉的匕首还是抵上了我的喉咙。

English: I thought I was dead. But she simply asked, "How would you like to be a merc?" ##And so they brought me back here, to their hideout: and three became four.
Chinese: 我以为死定了。但她只是问:"想不想当个雇佣兵?"##于是他们把我带回了这里,他们的藏身处:三人从此变成了四人。

English: You have to understand, stranger. I'd spent my youth cowering from the Union and their agents. My parents taught me all I know of Wikkan magic, of how to hear the language of cipher in all things; but when my parents vanished, I was left with no-one.
Chinese: 你得理解,陌生人。我的青春都在躲避联盟和他们的特工中度过。我关于维坎魔法的一切、关于如何聆听万物中密文语言的本领,都是父母教的;可父母失踪后,我便孤身一人。

English: When I told Vela my story, she wept and embraced me. It had been... a ((long)) time since I'd felt the touch of another person.
Chinese: 我把我的故事讲给薇拉听,她哭了,紧紧抱住我。从我上一次感受另一个人的触碰,已经过了好……((久))。

English: And looking into her eyes was like... staring into the void. Normally, stranger, I can read people; catch a glimpse of what's to come. But Vela? Her future was a tangle of infinite possibility. She was unreadable. It was ((intoxicating)).
Chinese: 而凝视她的双眼,就像……凝视虚空。通常,陌生人,我能读懂人心;瞥见即将发生的事。但薇拉?她的未来是无限可能的乱麻。她无法被读懂。这让人((迷醉))。

English: Those first few years with the Dark Stars? It was the first time I felt like I ((belonged)) somewhere. My comrades didn't fear my cipher, they ((relied)) on it.
Chinese: 和黑星一起的头几年?那是我头一次感觉自己((属于))某个地方。同伴们不惧怕我的密文,他们((依靠))它。

English: You never mentioned you were a Dark Star.
Chinese: 你从没提过自己是黑星的人。

English: <<She smirks.>> That wouldn't be very ((mysterious)) of me now, would it? I have a certain reputation to uphold, being a ghost and all.
Chinese: <<她窃笑。>>那样我就不够((神秘))了,不是吗?我可是有形象要维持的,毕竟身为幽灵。

English: Besides, as far as I'm concerned, the Dark Star company that ((I)) knew... is gone.
Chinese: 再说,在我看来,我((认识))的那个黑星佣兵团……已经不在了。

English: You had it tough, growing up. I'm sorry.
Chinese: 你成长的经历真苦。我很抱歉。

English: No more than any other Wikkan in living memory. In truth, I was lucky. Vela, for all her flaws... she ((saved)) me.
Chinese: 不比记忆中任何一个维坎人更苦。说实话,我已经算幸运了。薇拉纵有千般缺点……她((救))了我。

English: In those early days of the Dark Stars, Vela took contracts from anyone - the Union, the Wikkans, even outlaws - but it was about the ((cause)), not the coin.
Chinese: 黑星早期,薇拉什么人的委托都接——联盟的、维坎的、甚至是法外之徒的——但重要的是((信念)),不是钱。

English: She couldn't stand the thought of being like her father, whose military campaigns had wrought so much upheaval. So if a contract smelled fishy, we turned it down and went hungry. We didn't mind.
Chinese: 她无法忍受变得像她父亲那样,他的征伐造成了太多动荡。所以委托若有蹊跷,我们就拒绝,然后挨饿。我们不在乎。

English: But when we took a job? ((Nothing)) could stop us. It wasn't long before our numbers swelled and we outgrew this tiny cave. Soon enough, everyone from the lowest ruffian to the loftiest noble knew of the ((Dark Stars)).
Chinese: 可一旦接了活?((什么都))拦不住我们。没过多久,我们的队伍壮大,这座小山洞已经装不下。很快,从最底层的恶棍到最高贵的贵族,人人都知道了((黑星))的大名。

English: What made people want to follow Vela?
Chinese: 是什么让人们愿意追随薇拉?

English: Vela cajoled us all with intoxicating dreams. We weren't just gonna get rich; we were going to ((build)) something that neither the Union nor the Wikkans had. A place free from gods or masters. A paradise. A ((heaven))...
Chinese: 薇拉用令人迷醉的梦想把我们所有人都拢在一起。我们不只要发财;我们要((建造))一件联盟和维坎都不曾有过的东西。一个没有神也没有主人的地方。一座乐园。一座((天堂))……

English: Those times were the happiest of my life. We fought together, drank and danced together, ((dreamed)) together. But... it was not to last.
Chinese: 那些时光是我一生中最快乐的日子。我们一起战斗,一起喝酒跳舞,一起((做梦))。但……好景不长。

English: So what went wrong?
Chinese: 那么是哪里出了问题?

English: To pay the new recruits Vela had to be less ((scrupulous)) with her contracts. I clashed with her at times - when she slew the minor god Cernun, I flew into a rage... I never wanted the blood of a god on my hands.
Chinese: 为了养活新招募的人手,薇拉的契约不得不((不再那么挑剔))。我时不时与她起冲突——她杀了小神塞尔努时,我勃然大怒……我从来不想让神之血沾上自己的手。

English: But it was when she found that damned Emberian ((key)) that things really got out of hand.
Chinese: 但直到她找到那把该死的余烬((钥匙)),事情才真正失控。

English: There's an island, drifting to the [[north-west of the Clockwork Kingdom]], that contains the wreckage of the [[Black Goblin Airship.]] Meet me there, and I will finish this story.
Chinese: 有一座岛,漂在[[发条王国西北]]方向,[[黑哥布林号飞艇]]的残骸就在那里。到那里见我,我会把这个故事讲完。

English: This pile of junk was once the most fearsome pirate ship of the Skyrealms;  the [[Black Goblin]]. Merchants from Puria to Al-Asphra feared its volley of cipher-inscribed cannonballs.
Chinese: 这堆废铁曾是天空领域最令人生畏的海盗船;[[黑哥布林号]]。从普利亚到阿斯弗拉的商人们,都惧怕它那排刻着密文的炮弹齐射。

English: The Union Navy paid us a fortune to headhunt its captain. In the end, we got the coin ((and)) the ship. Few dared cross the Dark Stars, after that.
Chinese: 联盟海军出重金雇我们去猎杀它的船长。最后,赏金和船我们都((拿到))了。从那以后,少有人敢与黑星作对。

English: How did you win the ship battle?
Chinese: 那场船战你们是怎么赢的?

English: We were going up against a galleon with a tiny schooner. We had two guns; they had twenty per side. By anyone's measure, it was pure suicide.
Chinese: 我们是用一艘小小的双桅船去对抗一艘大帆船。我们有两门炮;他们每舷二十门。无论按谁的标准,这都是纯粹的自杀。

English: But I've always had a certain... ((knack)) for foresight. I knew they would commit their starboard, so we had the better of them.
Chinese: 但我向来有种……预知的((天赋))。我知道他们会把右舷全部压上,于是我们占了上风。

English: Before they knew it, we had one of our guns pointing straight at their rear. But this was not ((any)) old gun. It was one of Caxton Frost's cannons. A single blast from that thing tore straight through the whole ship, setting it ablaze.
Chinese: 等他们察觉时,我们已有一门炮直指他们的船尾。但那可不是((随便))一门旧炮。那是卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特造的加农炮。那东西一炮就轰穿了整艘船,把它点成了火炬。

English: In the confusion, our boarding party was on deck. We were eight against a hundred, but with a few words from the Duchess they found their swords to be... ((awfully)) heavy. Orlaith cut through swathes of them, carving a path to their captain.
Chinese: 趁着混乱,我们的接舷队登上了甲板。我们八个人对抗一百个,但女公爵的几句话一出口,他们就发觉自己的剑……((沉得))抬不起来。奥莱丝在敌群中杀出一条血路,直逼他们的船长。

English: By the time Vela had her sword to his neck, he had soiled himself. The ship was ours, and that night we got so ((plastered)) from their stores of rum I accidentally ((exploded)) a silkslug. That poor thing...
Chinese: 等薇拉的剑架上他的脖颈,他已经吓得屁滚尿流。船成了我们的,那天夜里,我们喝光他们窖藏的朗姆酒,醉得((不省人事)),我居然不小心把一只丝蛞蝓给((炸))了。那可怜的小东西……

English: So what went wrong?
Chinese: 那么是哪里出了问题?

English: After the Black Goblin, came the Blinding Light. A mercenary company with a galleon is impressive; but with a God War ((fortress?)) None could best us.
Chinese: 黑哥布林号之后,便是炫光要塞。一家佣兵公司有一艘大帆船已够唬人;但拥有一座神之战((堡垒?))没人能胜过我们。

English: But it was around then that Vela and Orlaith stumbled upon a ((map)), deep in some Emberian ruin. It told of the Cradle, buried far below in the Underlands, which held the power to change ((everything)).
Chinese: 但大约在那时,薇拉和奥莱丝在某处余烬遗迹深处偶然发现了一张((地图))。它记载着摇篮,深埋在地下之地之下,蕴藏着能改变((一切))的力量。

English: Vela was always ambitious. We thought she really ((could)) build her fantasy; a heaven of her own making. But now she was speaking of something else entirely. She wanted to become a ((god)). To change the very fabric of reality...
Chinese: 薇拉向来野心勃勃。我们以为她说的是她真能((建成))那个幻想;一座亲手打造的天堂。但此刻她说的完全是另一回事。她想成为((神))。想改变现实的根基……

English: But why? To what end?
Chinese: 可为什么?为了什么?
