English: She claims that she would right all the world's wrongs. Balance the scales, so the common folk can live like nobles and rulers no longer lust for war.
Chinese: 她声称她将匡正世间一切不公。摆正天平,让平民像贵族一样生活,让统治者不再贪恋战争。

English: So what happened next?
Chinese: 那么后来发生了什么?

English: The crew was split. Some were eager to follow her to the Underlands, especially if it would make them even more rich. But many of us thought she had crossed into ((madness)). ##Her fame had twisted to infamy, and even the Inquisition now considered us criminals.
Chinese: 船员分裂了。一些人热切地愿意随她前往地下之地,尤其是如果那能让他们更富。但我们中的许多人认为她已经跨入((疯狂))。##她的名声扭曲成了恶名,连宗教裁判所现在都视我们为罪犯。

English: From infancy, I had learned to listen to the language of the cosmos. Cipher flows through all things; its grammar and syntax weave through our bodies and dreams alike. To ((change)) those rules, for me, would be a bigger heresy than slaying a thousand gods...
Chinese: 从幼年起,我就学着聆听宇宙的语言。密文流经万物;它的语法和句法编织着我们的身体与梦境。((篡改))那些规则,对我而言,比弑杀千神更加亵渎……

English: So when Orlaith raised her sword against Vela and stirred the crew of the Black Goblin to ((mutiny))... I was willing to spill my own blood for the cause.
Chinese: 于是当奥莱丝对薇拉举剑,煽动黑哥布林号的船员((叛变))时……我愿意为这个信念洒尽自己的血。

English: ...and spill it I would.
Chinese: ……而血,我确实洒了。

English: In truth, I knew the Black Goblin stood no chance against a God War fortress. The Blinding Light's guns tore through our hull in moments, leaving us sinking towards the clouds.
Chinese: 说实话,我知道黑哥布林号对阵神之战堡垒毫无胜算。炫光要塞的火炮顷刻撕穿了我们的船壳,我们开始朝云层坠去。

English: Through the smoke and the chaos, I saw Vela board our ship. She was ((furious)). Her and Orlaith were like sisters; she couldn't take the betrayal. Through the haze of battle I saw their blades clash, and I saw Orlaith, her defence broken, hurled from the side of the ship.
Chinese: 在硝烟与混乱中,我看见薇拉登上了我们的船。她((怒不可遏))。她和奥莱丝情同姐妹;她无法承受这背叛。在战场的烟霭中,我看见她们的刀剑相击,我看见奥莱丝防御崩溃,被从船舷掷出。

English: And then a ((crash)) like I've never felt before. The ship had run aground. When I came to - in this very spot - Vela stood overhead, staring right at me. I was bloody, wounded... but Vela just turned and walked away.
Chinese: 然后是前所未有的((轰然巨响))。船搁浅了。等我醒转——就在此处——薇拉就站在头顶,直直地盯着我。我浑身是血,遍体鳞伤……但薇拉只是转身走开了。

English: It was at that moment... ((I)) was born. This spectral echo of my former self. ##I tried to scream, I tried to cry; but I had not yet learned how to... coalesce into a body, a shape.
Chinese: 就在那一刻……((我))诞生了。这个昔日自我的幽魂回声。##我想尖叫,我想痛哭;但我还没学会如何……凝聚成躯体,化作形体。

English: So I watched my corporeal body, my former self, lie there... barely clinging to life. I watched the Inquisition agents arrive, and I saw her scream as they dragged her away.
Chinese: 于是我眼看着我的肉身,那个曾经的我,躺在那里……奄奄一息。我看着宗教裁判所特工赶到,我看见她被拖走时的尖叫。

English: I watched as they threw her in a cell, and their instruments of agony tore into her flesh. I watched as her will broke, and she spilled every secret she knew. I watched as they destroyed her.
Chinese: 我看着他们把她扔进牢房,他们的刑具撕扯着她的血肉。我看着她的意志崩溃,吐露了她所知的一切秘密。我看着他们毁掉了她。

English: I'm so sorry.
Chinese: 我很难过。

English: Spare no tears for me, stranger. I have long abandoned self-pity.
Chinese: 别为我流泪,陌生人。我早已抛弃了自怜。

English: Does that mean... another version of you still lives?
Chinese: 这是不是意味着……另一个你还活着?

English: <<She grins.>> Of course, stranger. It's only in those old fairy tales of the middle ages that one has to ((die)) to become a ghost.
Chinese: <<她咧嘴笑。>>当然,陌生人。只有在那些中世纪的老童话里,人才要((死))了才能变成幽灵。

English: In fact, you're well acquainted with my corporeal self. <<She winks.>> I'm sure you can figure out who.
Chinese: 其实,你对我的肉身再熟悉不过了。<<她眨眨眼。>>我相信你能猜到是谁。

English: So is it revenge you're after?
Chinese: 那么你是在寻求复仇吗?

English: When I saw Vela standing over me, in that moment of my creation? It was not hatred I felt. It was... ((heartbreak)).
Chinese: 当我看见薇拉站在我上方,在我诞生的那一刻?我感到的不是恨。是……((心碎))。

English: For I loved her, stranger. I loved her dearly. And suddenly I saw all those possible futures I had scried - all those joyous fantasies - just... melt away.  ##The Vela I saw was the Vela I had always feared.
Chinese: 因为我爱她,陌生人。我深深地爱着她。而突然间,我窥见过的那些可能的未来——那些欢乐的幻想——就那么……融化了。##我看见的薇拉,是我一直害怕的那个薇拉。

English: So no, stranger, I seek no revenge; I hold no hatred in my heart - if I can be said to have one at all.
Chinese: 所以不,陌生人,我不求复仇;我心中没有恨——如果我还称得上有一颗心的话。

English: <<She closes her eyes.>> I just want this all to stop. I want to see her ((smile)) again...
Chinese: <<她闭上眼睛。>>我只想让这一切停下来。我只想再见她((微笑))一次……

English: Thanks for the story.
Chinese: 谢谢你讲的故事。

English: I'm glad you listened, stranger. Soon enough you'll face Vela again, and now you may have one single advantage over her...
Chinese: 我很高兴你愿意听,陌生人。很快你就会再面对薇拉,而现在你或许拥有一个胜过她的优势……

English: ...you may ((understand)) her.
Chinese: ……你或许能((理解))她。

English: It seems that Vela Callose drove her sword through your chest.
Chinese: 看来薇拉·卡洛斯的剑穿透了你的胸膛。

English: You were moments from death. I plucked you from certain peril and mended your broken heart, before the void could claim you.
Chinese: 你离死亡只差分毫。在虚空把你夺走之前,我把你从必死的险境中拽出,修补了你破碎的心。

English: Truth be told, I have been watching you with great interest. This quest that you have undertaken is not without peril, and for some time I have been poised to save you from certain defeat.
Chinese: 说实话,我一直饶有兴味地注视着你。你接下的这趟任务并非毫无凶险,而我早已蓄势待发,随时准备把你从必败中拯救出来。

English: That you have escaped death for this long, without my aid, is nothing short of remarkable.
Chinese: 没有我的帮助,你竟能逃过死亡这么久,简直不可思议。

English: But now it seems we have a common foe. ##Vela Callose, in her ((arrogance)), chained me here in shackles of voidsteel. I wish to be free, and so she must die.
Chinese: 但现在看来,我们有了共同的敌人。##薇拉·卡洛斯((狂妄自大)),用虚空钢镣铐把我锁在这里。我渴望自由,所以她必须死。

English: A valiant effort, human. <<The words ring through your throbbing head.>>
Chinese: 壮烈的一搏,人类。<<这些话语在你悸动的头颅中回响。>>

English: Vela - I was... so close...
Chinese: 薇拉——我明明……就差一点……

English: Do not be disheartened. Vela's blade has cut down many foes more powerful than yourself.
Chinese: 不要气馁。薇拉的剑刃砍倒过许多比你强大的敌人。

English: Here we are again.
Chinese: 我们又见面了。

English: And once again I have plucked you from the jaws of death...
Chinese: 而我又一次把你从死亡的血盆大口中拽了回来……

English: ...but the number of times I have done so is relatively few, human. You have done well to evade defeat thus far. The High Confessor was wise to entrust you with this burden.
Chinese: ……不过我这样做的次数相对寥寥,人类。你至今未曾败北,表现出色。至高忏悔者把这份重担托付给你,是明智之举。

English: ...And I have done so near countless times, across every strip of land on these Isles. ##Without my assistance, human, you wouldn't have had the slightest chance of getting this far.
Chinese: ……而我这样做的次数已近乎无数,遍及群岛的每一寸土地。##没有我的协助,人类,你连走到今天这一步的一丝可能都没有。

English: ...One of many times, I might say - though there is no shame in that. You have performed your task admirably.
Chinese: ……我只能说是多次之一——不过这没什么可羞愧的。你把任务完成得令人赞叹。

English: But confronting Vela ((again)) will prove a formidable challenge. The Emberian craft she has commandeered will not be so easily assailed a second time. ##To fight your way through, you will surely need my assistance.
Chinese: 但((再次))直面薇拉将是艰巨的挑战。她强占的那艘余烬飞行器,第二次可不会那么好攻打。##要杀出一条血路,你必定需要我的协助。

English: <<The entity rattles its chains.>> These voidsteel shackles are bound with Vela's magic. Only by her hand - or her ((death)) - will I be freed. I am placing my ((trust)) in you, human.
Chinese: <<那存在晃动着锁链。>>这些虚空钢镣铐用薇拉的魔法封印着。唯有她的手——或她的((死亡))——才能释放我。我把((信任))寄托在你身上,人类。

English: I won't let you down.
Chinese: 我不会让你失望的。

English: I guess I have no choice.
Chinese: 我想我没有别的选择了。

English: <<The deity nods its conjoined heads.>> ##Now make your way to the [[High Confessor]]. I believe she wishes to speak with you...
Chinese: <<那神明点了点它连在一起的头颅。>>##现在去找[[至高忏悔者]]吧。我想她有话要对你讲……

English: <<An authoritative voice booms from the ship's sound relays. You assume it belongs to Admiral Callose, of the Union Navy.>>
Chinese: <<一个威严的声音从飞船的扩音装置中轰然传出。你猜那是联盟海军的卡洛斯上将。>>

English: ...is simply ((out of the question.)) Need I ((remind)) you, High Confessor Caer, that your position of authority in this tribunal is in spite of your numerous crimes against the Union, most of which were committed alongside ((Vela)) herself.
Chinese: ……((根本不可能。))需要我((提醒))你吗,凯尔至高忏悔者?你能在这特别法庭中身居高位,是全然不顾你对联盟的累累罪行——其中大半还是与((薇拉))本人一同犯下的。

English: I care not if you sent an incorrigible band of felons to find my daughter; considering your ((history)) with Vela, I cannot in good conscience allow you - or your ((lackeys)) - anywhere near her.
Chinese: 我不在乎你派了一群无可救药的罪犯去找我女儿;鉴于你与薇拉的((渊源)),我绝不能凭良心容许你——或你的((走狗))——靠近她分毫。

English: So, you will use that dilapidated old relic of an airship to ((hold the flank)). You will not interfere with this operation, which is solely in the hands of the Apostatic Union Navy. You are ((Dismissed)).
Chinese: 所以,你要用那艘破烂的老古董飞艇去((守住侧翼))。你不得干涉本次行动,行动全权掌握在叛教联盟海军手中。你((退下))吧。

English: That insufferable ((fool.)) Of all the people responsible for this nightmare, he... is hardly blameless. If he had just been a ((father)) to Vela, when she needed one...
Chinese: 那个可恨的((蠢货))。在这场梦魇的罪人当中,他……绝非无辜。哪怕他在薇拉需要的时候,当一回((父亲))……

English: <<A loud clang rings out from the coffin.>> And now he would beat her at her own twisted game! They want to ((steal)) it, Confessor XVII. The Navy... wants the Cradle for themselves, so the Union's subjugation of the Skyrealms... is absolute.
Chinese: <<棺材里传来响亮的铿锵声。>>现在他还要在扭曲的游戏里赢过她!他们想((抢))走它,忏悔者十七世。海军……想把摇篮据为己有,好让联盟对天空领域的臣服……成为绝对。

English: Uh, I thought you were on the Union's side?
Chinese: 呃,我以为你是联盟那边的人?

English: Never. I ((despise)) these loathsome bastards. But I sing along to their tune, to keep myself... from a prison cell, same as you.
Chinese: 从不。我((憎恶))这些可憎的混蛋。但我顺着他们的调子唱,免得自己……进牢房,跟你一样。

English: And besides. This is the only way I can stop Vela. That's... all that matters to me now.
Chinese: 再说了。这是我拦住薇拉的唯一办法。如今……我只在乎这个。

English: So what are we going to do?
Chinese: 那我们该怎么办?

English: <<A sigh rings out.>> I suppose I will have to ((hold the flank))... just as Admiral Callose demands. It is too late, with too much at stake, to rock the boat now.
Chinese: <<一声叹息响起。>>看来我只能去((守住侧翼))……正如卡洛斯上将要求的那样。事已至此,牵涉太深,现在掀桌子已经太迟了。

English: So we just give up?
Chinese: 所以我们就这么放弃?

English: I did not ((say)) that, Confessor. We have... a card to play, yet.
Chinese: 我可没((那么))说,忏悔者。我们还有……一张牌可打。

English: There must be a way.
Chinese: 一定有办法的。

English: There is always a way, Confessor. We have... a card to play yet.
Chinese: 总会有办法的,忏悔者。我们还有……一张牌可打。

English: We should just let the Union have it.
Chinese: 我们干脆让联盟拿去好了。

English: Even if we let them, they would never succeed. Vela would sooner spark another ((World Rend))... than let her father have the Cradle. A scenario... that is looking more likely with each passing moment.
Chinese: 就算我们让给他们,他们也绝不会得逞。薇拉宁可再掀起一次((世界撕裂))……也不会让她父亲得到摇篮。而那种局面……正随着每一刻流逝愈发可能。

English: No, there is another way, Confessor. We have... a card to play yet.
Chinese: 不,还有别的办法,忏悔者。我们还有……一张牌可打。

English: While you were off getting yourself ((killed)), the rest of your team managed... to escape the Underlands aboard the cutter, thanks to Frost's repairs.
Chinese: 趁你忙着把自己((弄死))的时候,你的队伍其他成员多亏弗罗斯特的修理,总算……乘着那艘快艇逃出了地下之地。

English: As you have no doubt noticed, the Cradle... has made its ascent to the Skyrealms. The Union Navy, finally realising the ((gravity)) of the situation, showed up... in full force.
Chinese: 你肯定已经注意到,摇篮……已经升入天空领域。联盟海军终于意识到事态的((严重性)),倾巢而出。

English: But they can't punch through... the Cradle's defensive shield. Some sort of highly advanced Emberian tech. So for the moment... They are at a stalemate.
Chinese: 但他们攻不破……摇篮的防御护盾。某种极其先进的余烬科技。所以眼下……双方陷入僵局。

English: So all ((we)) have to do... is slip past both. Pilot the cutter... and sneak your strike team past the largest fleet in the world, and through an impenetrable Emberian shield... to stop the most dangerous person alive. ##What could be simpler?
Chinese: 所以((我们))要做的……就是从两边中间溜过去。驾驶快艇……带着你的突击队瞒过世界上最庞大的舰队,再穿过一面无法穿透的余烬护盾……去拦住世上最危险的人。##还能有比这更简单的吗?

English: That's impossible.
Chinese: 这不可能。

English: In our current situation... I would agree. But there are secrets scattered around these isles that may be able to help us.
Chinese: 就目前的处境而言……我同意。但群岛各处散落着一些秘密,或许能帮上我们。

English: How would we get past the fleet?
Chinese: 我们要怎么穿过舰队?

English: In its current state, the cutter would be detected at once... by the Navy's aeronautical wizards. But Caxton Frost has an idea.
Chinese: 以快艇现在的状态,会被海军的航空巫师……立刻发现。不过卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特有个主意。

English: There are legends... of an ancient Emberian sky-craft. A phantom vessel, able to break any barrier... or evade any pursuit. Said to be wrecked in the World Rend... never to be seen again.
Chinese: 有一些传说……关于一种古老的余烬飞行器。一艘幽灵船,能击破任何屏障……或甩脱任何追兵。据说它毁于世界撕裂……从此再无人见过。

English: Many have searched... for the [[crashed vessel]]. Without success. Scryers find nothing, or... suffer apoplexy. The Union Navy considers it... merely a myth.
Chinese: 许多人搜寻过……那艘[[坠毁的飞船]]。都无功而返。窥探师们一无所获,或者……当场中风。联盟海军认为它……只是个神话。

English: Frost... believes otherwise. There were rumours... of a particular island, with an Emberian wreck, that has been drifting through the Skyrealms. That very island... has strayed into the Oneiric Isles.
Chinese: 弗罗斯特……却不这么想。有传言说……有一座特定的岛,上面有一具余烬残骸,一直在天空领域漂荡。那座岛……刚刚漂进了梦幻群岛。

English: Search the [[most distant islands]] in the Oneiric Isles, and find... whatever [[power]] it is that hides the wreck... from scrying minds. ##Then... you might slip past the Navy blockade.
Chinese: 去搜寻梦幻群岛[[最偏远的岛屿]],找出究竟是何种[[力量]]……让那具残骸躲过了窥探者的心智。##然后……你或许就能溜过海军的封锁。

English: So how can I actually ((get)) to those islands?
Chinese: 那我到底要怎么((去))那些岛?

English: You cannot pilot the cutter, as Frost... needs to modify it... before your assault on the Cradle.
Chinese: 你不能驾驶快艇,因为弗罗斯特……需要改装它……以备你们强攻摇篮。

English: No... it seems you will need [[your own airship.]]
Chinese: 不行……看来你需要[[自己的飞艇]]。

English: ...You will, of course, need your own [[airship]]. Remember to use the [[Writ of Permission]] I gave you.
Chinese: ……当然,你需要[[自己的飞艇]]。记得用我给你的[[飞行许可状]]。

English: Take this [[Writ of Permission.]] It will help you bypass the bureaucratic... ((nightmare)) of purchasing a vessel from the [[Winged Merchants Guild.]]
Chinese: 拿着这份[[飞行许可状]]。它能帮你绕开从[[飞翼商会]]购船时那官僚主义的……((噩梦))。

English: As for the hefty fee you will no doubt be required to pay... I cannot help you. Our coffers... are empty, I'm afraid.
Chinese: 至于你毫无疑问要支付的高昂费用……我帮不了你。我们的金库……恐怕是空的。

English: And take this time... to make sure you are [[fully prepared]] for the fight ahead. I do not think this situation... will resolve any time soon, and assaulting the Cradle... will be no easy task.
Chinese: 趁这段时间……确保你为接下来的战斗[[做足准备]]。我认为这个局面……短期内不会解决,而强攻摇篮……绝非易事。

English: Now, you should get going. I have... my own ((troubles)) to attend to.
Chinese: 现在,你该走了。我还有……自己的((麻烦))要处理。

English: Got it.
Chinese: 明白了。

English: Good. you are dismissed.
Chinese: 好。你可以走了。

English: What troubles?
Chinese: 什么麻烦?

English: Oh, it is a rather... ((delicate)) matter. If I am honest, your help... would be appreciated.
Chinese: 哦,那是一件相当……((微妙))的事。说实话,若能得到你的帮助……我将不胜感激。

English: Oh, Confessor XVII. I have another... assignment for you. This one is of a more... ((delicate)) nature.
Chinese: 哦,忏悔者十七世。我还有一件……差事交给你。这一件性质更加……((微妙))。

English: As you have no doubt noticed, there are tensions between this tribunal... and the wider Union. Both the Navy and my Inquisition superiors... have begun to ((question)) my loyalty to the cause.
Chinese: 你肯定已经注意到,本法庭……与联盟高层之间关系紧张。海军和我在宗教裁判所的上级……都开始((质疑))我对事业的忠诚。

English: So they have asked me... to issue a command they know I will find... <<She inhales throatily, >> ((disagreeable)).
Chinese: 于是他们要求我……下达一道他们明知我会觉得……<<她喉头喑哑地吸气,>>((不快的))命令。

English: There is a [[small house]] in the [[western forest of Hallowshire]], where our agents have stumbled upon a certain [[godlet]].
Chinese: [[哈洛郡西部的森林]]里有一座[[小屋]],我们的特工在那里偶然发现了一位[[稚神]]。

English: This tiny stunted god would be of little significance, only... my superiors ((know)) that in years past, it was in my care. That I was... ((fond)) of the thing.
Chinese: 这个矮小萎缩的神本无足轻重,只是……我的上级((知道)),多年以前,它曾由我照看。我曾……((喜爱))这东西。

English: <<She is silent a moment.>> This is not the time... to arouse their suspicions. You must go to this godlet. You must... <<she swallows, slowly.>> ...((slay it)), on my orders. And then... we will continue as normal.
Chinese: <<她沉默了片刻。>>现在不是……惹起他们疑心的时候。你必须去找这位稚神。你必须……<<她缓缓咽了口唾沫。>>……奉我之命,((杀了它))。然后……我们一切照旧。

English: Okay, I'll kill it for you.
Chinese: 好吧,我替你杀了它。

English: Thank you... Confessor. ##Remember: you will find it in the [[western forest]] of Hallowshire.
Chinese: 谢谢你……忏悔者。##记住:你会在哈洛郡的[[西部森林]]找到它。

English: Take this [[Void Scalpel]]. Only Voidsteel can harm a god. Use it to slit its throat.
Chinese: 拿着这把[[虚空手术刀]]。唯有虚空钢能伤到神。用它割开它的喉咙。

English: Tell me about this godlet.
Chinese: 跟我说说这位稚神。

English: <<She slams the inside of the coffin.>> Does it ((matter)), Confessor? They are the shrivelled, pathetic forms of diminished gods. There have been thousands scattered around the skyrealms... since the God War.
Chinese: <<她捶打棺材内壁。>>这((重要))吗,忏悔者?它们是衰微之神干瘪可怜的形骸。自神之战以来,天空各处散落着成千上万这样的东西……

English: The Inquisition destroys more of them... every day. ((This)) one is no different.
Chinese: 宗教裁判所每天都在销毁它们……((这一))个没什么不同。

English: I refuse to do this.
Chinese: 我拒绝做这件事。

English: If you do not have the stomach for it... I will find another.
Chinese: 你若没这个胆量……我会另找他人。

English: Fine by me.
Chinese: 随你便。

English: About that godlet you needed killing...
Chinese: 关于你要杀的那位稚神……

English: I have heard a report... that the godlet is dead. ##<<She sighs.>> Thank you, Confessor.
Chinese: 我听到报告……说稚神已经死了。##<<她叹息。>>谢谢你,忏悔者。

English: I found...
Chinese: 我找到了……

English: I was able to...
Chinese: 我本可以……

English: I didn't...
Chinese: 我没有……

English: <<She slams a mechanical limb into the ground.>> I do not want to hear... the details, Confessor. I am grateful for your assistance, and that... is all.
Chinese: <<她把一根机械肢体砸向地面。>>我不想听……细节,忏悔者。我感谢你的协助,仅此……而已。

English: <<She lets the silence hang. But as you turn to leave....>>## Except... for one thing. That damned ((ghost)). Was she there?
Chinese: <<她让沉默悬在空中。但当你转身欲走时……>>##不过……还有一件事。那个该死的((幽灵))。她在场吗?

English: She was there.
Chinese: 她在场。

English: That accursed spirit has haunted me for years. I suspected... that she might try and stop you.
Chinese: 那个可恶的魂灵纠缠了我多年。我料想……她可能会设法阻止你。

English: She hinted that you're... the same person.
Chinese: 她暗示你们是……同一个人。

English: Ghosts are nothing but... vestiges of trauma, singed upon reality. She is but an echo of my former self. Trapped in... naivety and idealism.
Chinese: 幽灵不过是……烙印在现实上的创伤残迹。她只是昔日自我的回声。困在……天真与理想主义之中。

English: <<She sighs.>> When I sailed with Vela, I wanted to use my Wikkan magic to heal this broken world. I thought there was always a... ((compromise)) to be found.
Chinese: <<她叹息。>>我与薇拉同航时,曾想用我的维坎魔法治愈这个破碎的世界。我以为总能找到……((折中))之道。

English: But it took months of Inquisition torture, and many more confined in an anti-cipher chamber, for my shattered mind... to see the ((truth)).
Chinese: 但经历了数月的宗教裁判所酷刑,以及更长久的反密文囚室禁闭,我破碎的心智……才看清((真相))。

English: There is only one thing... myself and that ((spirit)) agree on. That Vela... must be stopped. But only ((I)) have the guts to see it through.
Chinese: 我和那个((魂灵))只在……一件事上有共识。薇拉……必须被阻止。但只有((我))有胆量把它贯彻到底。

English: <<She breaks into a coughing fit, that settles into wheezing.>> We did the right thing, Confessor. We are ((doing)) the right thing.
Chinese: <<她一阵咳嗽发作,渐渐变成喘息。>>我们做的是对的,忏悔者。我们((正在))做对的事。

English: <<The High Confessor's coffin is being escorted away by her own agents.>> ##Let go of me, you fools! <<She coughs uncontrollably.>>
Chinese: <<至高忏悔者的棺材正被她自己的特工押送离开。>>##放开我,你们这些蠢货!<<她不受控制地咳嗽着。>>

English: <<She sees you.>> ((Confessor))! There you are, you ((traitor)). Do you know... what you have done?
Chinese: <<她看见了你。>>((忏悔者))!你在这里,你这个((叛徒))。你知道……你干了什么吗?

English: You think appeasing that damned ((spirit)) will stop this madness? That thing is not even ((real)). Just a shadow of my former self. A vestige of trauma... singed upon the skies.
Chinese: 你以为安抚那个该死的((魂灵))就能阻止这场疯狂?那东西根本不是((真的))。只是昔日自我的影子。一道烙印在天空上的创伤残迹……

English: I'm sorry.
Chinese: 我很抱歉。

English: You deserved this.
Chinese: 你活该。

English: <<She exhales a deep, raspy breath.>> Listen, Confessor XVII. They'll throw me in a cell with no lock, from which I'll never see the light of a neuron star again. But I won't... ((resent)) you. I won't curse your name. So long... as you do ((one thing)).
Chinese: <<她深深地、嘶哑地呼出一口气。>>听着,忏悔者十七世。他们会把我扔进一间没有锁的牢房,从那里我将再也见不到神经元星的光。但我不会……((怨恨))你。我不会诅咒你的名字。只要……你做((一件事))。

English: ((Vela.)) Crush her skull, and shatter her bones. For what... she ((did)) to me...
Chinese: ((薇拉。))砸碎她的头骨,打断她的骨头。为了她对我……((做的))那些事……

English: <<You hear her faintly sobbing inside the coffin.>>
Chinese: <<你听见她在棺材里低声啜泣。>>

English: Ah, so it seems as though you have secured... all the necessary components, Confessor. Basalt informs me... that the cutter is ready.
Chinese: 啊,看来你已经备齐……了所有必要的部件,忏悔者。巴索特告诉我……快艇已经就绪。

English: This will be your... ((final)) mission. For after this, I will declare your penance... fulfilled. You will be free to roam the Skyrealms once more.
Chinese: 这将是你……((最后))一次任务。因为这之后,我将宣布你的赎罪……已履行完毕。你将重获自由,漫游天空领域。

English: But I wanted to offer you... a place here, in this tribunal. If you wished to... serve the Inquisition alongside me.
Chinese: 但我想邀请你……留在这里,加入本法庭。若你愿意……与我一同效力宗教裁判所。

English: Thank you. I'd gladly join the Inquisition.
Chinese: 谢谢你。我很乐意加入宗教裁判所。

English: That is... good to hear, Confessor. You will make... an exceptional agent.
Chinese: 那……太好了,忏悔者。你会成为……一名杰出的特工。

English: I'd rather find my own path.
Chinese: 我宁愿寻找自己的路。

English: I respect your wishes, Confessor. Perhaps I would do the same, were I not bound... to this coffin.
Chinese: 我尊重你的意愿,忏悔者。若不是被缚在这口棺材里……或许我也会这样做。

English: I despise this institution. I'd sooner see it burn.
Chinese: 我鄙夷这个机构。我宁可看它烧成灰。

English: <<She chuckles gutturally.>> In truth, I don't blame you, Confessor. Though I guess I'll have to... watch my back.
Chinese: <<她喉头咯咯轻笑。>>说实话,我不怪你,忏悔者。不过我想我得多……提防身后了。

English: But... back to the task at hand.
Chinese: 但……回到手头的任务。

English: You will assemble your strike team... for this final assignment. You will approach the [[Cradle]] in the [[cutter]], and fight your way through Vela's defences.
Chinese: 你要为这最后一项任务……集结你的突击队。你们将乘[[快艇]]接近[[摇篮]],杀穿薇拉的防线。

English: We've seen no sign of aberrant behaviour, from the Cradle. So we can only assume... that Vela has not yet awakened the creature within. You must ((kill)) her... before she can do any harm.
Chinese: 我们没有观察到摇篮的任何异动。所以我们只能假定……薇拉尚未唤醒其中的造物。你必须在她造成任何危害之前……((杀掉))她。

English: Okay.
Chinese: 好吧。

English: ((Kill)) her? Why not capture?
Chinese: ((杀))她?为什么不活捉?

English: You did not... sail with her, back in those days. You did not ((love)) her, as I did. You were not ((betrayed)) by her, and left to die!
Chinese: 当年你没有……与她同航。你不曾像我那样((爱))过她。你没有被她((背叛)),弃之待死!

English: <<She gasps for breath.>> If left to enact her plans, Vela will be the death of us all. That woman deserves nothing better than death.
Chinese: <<她喘着气。>>若放任她施行计划,薇拉将置我们所有人于死地。那个女人只配一死。

English: Actually, I want to help her.
Chinese: 其实,我想帮她。

English: <<She laughs maniacally.>> You wouldn't believe how many people I've heard those words from. Vela has a way of creeping into your mind. Making you ((adore)) her
Chinese: <<她狂笑。>>你不会相信我从多少人嘴里听过这句话。薇拉有本事钻进你的脑海。让你((迷恋))她

English: But do not be swayed by her rhetoric. She will be the death of us all.
Chinese: 但不要被她的花言巧语左右。她会葬送我们所有人。

English: Anyway, it matters not. If you will not do the deed, Orlaith ((will)).
Chinese: 总之,这不重要。你若不肯动手,奥莱丝((会))的。

English: Just get the cutter docked with the Cradle, and the rest of your team will begin the assault. Expect fierce resistance. ((Sacrifices)) may be necessary... We may not all meet again.
Chinese: 只要把快艇对接上摇篮,你队伍里的其他人就会开始强攻。准备好迎接顽强的抵抗。((牺牲))可能在所难免……我们未必都能再见。

English: But know this: I have come to... ((respect)) you, Confessor. I trust that when it comes to it... you will do the right thing.
Chinese: 但你要知道:我已经开始……((敬重))你了,忏悔者。我相信真到了那一刻……你会做正确的事。

English: Thank you for what you did back there, stranger. Not all would have done as you did.
Chinese: 谢谢你刚才做的事,陌生人。不是所有人都会像你这样做。

English: Don't spare any tears for the High Confessor. It hardly pleases me to see my true self brought so low, but... she dug her own grave by siding with these authoritarian ((bastards)).
Chinese: 别为至高忏悔者掉一滴眼泪。看到真正的自己落得如此下场,我也高兴不起来,但……她站到这些威权((混蛋))一边,是自掘坟墓。

English: <<She smirks.>> Oh, don't worry; they can't see or hear me. I may be a ghost, but I can still weave a simple concealment spell.
Chinese: <<她窃笑。>>哦,别担心;他们看不见也听不见我。我虽是幽灵,但织个简单的隐匿咒还是没问题的。

English: Do I have to follow Inquisitor Ignavius' orders, then?
Chinese: 那我还得听伊格纳修斯审判官的命令吗?

English: I wouldn't worry about ((him)); that bumbling fool hasn't the slightest clue what's going on.
Chinese: 别为((他))操心;那个冒失的蠢货根本不知道发生了什么。

English: What should I do?
Chinese: 我该怎么做?

English: My ((personal)) feelings for the High Confessor aside, her plan is still your best chance of getting close to Vela.
Chinese: 撇开我对至高忏悔者的((个人))感情不谈,她的计划依然是你接近薇拉的最好机会。

English: You just have to find the [[crashed Emberian ship]] and its [[engine]], so you can slip onto the Cradle.
Chinese: 你只需找到[[坠毁的余烬飞船]]和它的[[引擎]],就能悄悄登上摇篮。

English: How do I find this engine?
Chinese: 我怎么找到这个引擎?

English: The High Confessor said it was aboard the crashed ship on an island somewhere, right?
Chinese: 至高忏悔者说它在某座岛上的坠毁飞船里,对吧?

English: Search for it by sailing to the [[most distant islands]] - then you could use this device to sneak the cutter through the Union Navy blockade.
Chinese: 开船去[[最偏远的岛屿]]找它——然后你就能用这个装置让快艇悄悄穿过联盟海军的封锁。

English: Thanks, Caer.
Chinese: 谢了,凯尔。

English: Good luck, stranger.
Chinese: 祝你好运,陌生人。

English: Welcome back, Confessor.
Chinese: 欢迎回来,忏悔者。

English: Remember: you will find it in the [[western forest]] of Hallowshire. ##Use the [[Void Knife]] I gave you. Only Voidsteel can harm a god. Use it to slit its throat.
Chinese: 记住:你会在哈洛郡的[[西部森林]]找到它。##用我给你的[[虚空刀]]。唯有虚空钢能伤到神。用它割开它的喉咙。

English: Changed your mind, have you?
Chinese: 改变主意了,是吧?

English: About my mission...
Chinese: 关于我的任务……

English: Looks like you've done it, stranger. The cutter's been fitted with those fancy gadgets, and you're all set to slip aboard the Cradle without anyone being any the wiser.
Chinese: 看来你办成了,陌生人。快艇已经装上那些精巧的小玩意,你们可以神不知鬼不觉地登上摇篮了。

English: If you really manage to pull it off, I doubt the Inquisition will notice if a single Confessor goes missing in the chaos. <<She winks.>> ##So tell me, stranger - if you make it through this, what will you do next?
Chinese: 你要是真能成事,我猜乱局之中少了一个忏悔者,宗教裁判所根本不会发觉。<<她眨眨眼。>>##那么告诉我,陌生人——若你挺过这一关,接下来打算做什么?

English: I have no intention of leaving. I'll stay with the Inquisition.
Chinese: 我没打算离开。我要留在宗教裁判所。

English: <<She frowns.>> Freedom beckons, and yet you'd rather stay a ((prisoner))? For ((these)) idiots?
Chinese: <<她皱眉。>>自由在召唤,你却宁愿继续当((囚犯))?为了((这帮))蠢货?

English: Well, each to their own, stranger - but I expected better from ((you)) of all people.
Chinese: 好吧,人各有志,陌生人——但偏偏是((你)),我可是期望更高的。

English: I'll just see where the wind takes me.
Chinese: 我就随风去哪儿算哪儿。

English: Ah, a free spirit, eh? I've no doubt you'll make ((quite)) the adventurer.
Chinese: 啊,自由之魂,是吧?毫不怀疑你会成为((了不得的))冒险家。

English: I'll have my revenge on these Inquisition pricks.
Chinese: 我要向宗教裁判所这些蠢货复仇。

English: <<She chuckles.>> Now you're speaking my language. If I had a body of flesh and blood, I'd gladly join you, stranger.
Chinese: <<她轻笑。>>这下说到我心坎里了。若我还有血肉之躯,我乐意与你同行,陌生人。

English: But... I suppose you shouldn't count your eggsacs before they've burst, eh? That Cradle isn't going to assault itself.
Chinese: 不过……我想你别急着数还没爆开的卵囊,对吧?摇篮可不会自己强攻自己。

English: It seems like your companions are ready for the fight ahead. All you have to do is take the [[cutter]] and depart for the [[Cradle]]. If anyone can get to Vela, you lot can.
Chinese: 看来你的同伴们已经为接下来的战斗做好准备。你只需登上[[快艇]],启程前往[[摇篮]]。若有人能近薇拉的身,那就是你们了。

English: And if anyone can stop her... well. I don't know. Many wise heads have been turned by Vela's grandiose dreams before. I fear you may be tempted too.
Chinese: 而若有人能拦住她……嗯。我不知道。从前多少聪明头脑都被薇拉的宏大梦想俘获。恐怕你也难逃诱惑。

English: I won't tell you what to do when you meet Vela face to face. That's for ((you)) to decide, stranger. But I trust when it comes to it... you'll do what's ((right)).
Chinese: 面对面遇见薇拉时该怎么做,我不会指手画脚。那要由((你))来决定,陌生人。但我相信真到了那一刻……你会做((对))的事。

English: Bastards! Are these Inquisition ((scum)) friends of yours, stranger? Or should I say ((Confessor)), now?
Chinese: 混蛋!这些宗教裁判所((渣滓))是你的朋友吗,陌生人?或者我现在该叫你((忏悔者))了?

English: I've been sent here to kill a godlet.
Chinese: 我被派来这里杀一位稚神。

English: I've been given a task that I don't want to do.
Chinese: 我接到了一件我不想做的差事。

English: She's sent you to kill Danu, hasn't she?
Chinese: 她派你来杀达努,对不对?

English: <<Her eyes burn with fury.>> That ((bitch))! ##So she would betray us, and everything we once held dear? Just to get to ((Vela))?
Chinese: <<她眼中燃烧着怒火。>>那个((贱人))!##她竟要背叛我们,背叛我们曾经珍视的一切?就为了接近((薇拉))?

English: Do you know this place?
Chinese: 你认识这个地方?

English: ((Know)) it? It's my ((home)). The last place I settled, with my parents, before they... <<She chokes on her words.>>
Chinese: ((认识))?这是我的((家))。我与父母最后安顿的地方,在他们……<<她说不下去了。>>

English: Just get out of my way.
Chinese: 别挡我的路。

English: Listen, stranger. You don't have to do this. The High Confessor, you - you don't ((owe)) her anything! She's ((using)) you!
Chinese: 听着,陌生人。你不必这么做。至高忏悔者……你什么都不((欠))她的!她在((利用))你!

English: <<Spectral tears fall from her face, shimmering in the light as they dissipate.>> ##((Please)), stranger. Use that [[knife]] to cut its bonds, not to... to...
Chinese: <<幽灵般的眼泪从她脸上滚落,在光芒中闪烁着消散。>>##((求你)),陌生人。用那把[[刀]]割断它的束缚,而不是……而不是……

English: <<She sniffs and swallows, but says nothing more.>>
Chinese: <<她吸了吸鼻子,咽下话头,再没说什么。>>

English: <<The godlet emits a soft, sad sound that seems to echo through your bones.>>
Chinese: <<稚神发出一声轻柔的哀鸣,仿佛在你骨中回荡。>>

English: Her name... is Danu. ##In the middle ages she was a patron god of a powerful kingdom; a prophet who could predict - and ((change)) - the fate of empires...
Chinese: 她的名字……是达努。##中世纪时,她是一个强大王国的守护神;一位能预见——并((改写))——帝国命运的先知……

English: But after the God War, she was just... my ((friend)).
Chinese: 但神之战后,她只是……我的((朋友))。

English: My parents had been charged with keeping her safe from the Inquisition. Danu was grateful, and taught me how to master my ciphestry - how to read the threads of possibility that spill from all things, and catch glimpses of likely futures.
Chinese: 我父母受托保护她免遭宗教裁判所毒手。达努心怀感激,教我掌握密文术——如何解读从万物中流淌出的可能性之线,窥见可能的未来。

English: And... when my parents disappeared? It was just me and Danu.
Chinese: 而……当我父母失踪后?就只剩下我和达努。

English: When Vela found me and I became a Dark Star - I left Danu here, with charms and sigils for protection. Even now, in ((this)) form, I still look over her...
Chinese: 当薇拉找到我,我成了黑星的一员——我把达努留在这里,用护符和印记守护她。即便如今化作((这副))形态,我依然照看着她……

English: So why does the High Confessor want her dead?
Chinese: 那至高忏悔者为什么要她死?

English: Because she means a lot to me - to ((her)). ##It's... a test of loyalty.
Chinese: 因为她对我意义重大——对((她))也一样。##这是……一场忠诚测试。

English: Enough of the sob story, already.
Chinese: 催泪故事就到这儿吧。

English: ((Please)), just ((listen)) to me, stranger.
Chinese: ((求你)),((听))我说完,陌生人。

English: I am the ghost of the Dark Star [[Caer]]. I was born of the trauma she felt when she fell to her doom in the mutiny. ##But Caer did not ((die)); her heart still beats.
Chinese: 我是黑星[[凯尔]]的幽灵。我诞生于她在叛变中坠向毁灭时感到的创伤。##但凯尔并没有((死));她的心脏仍在跳动。

English: She was tortured for months by the Inquisition. Driven to madness with unspeakable tools and devices and then, when they were done with her, they threw her in a cipher-insulated cell. For the first time in her life she could not hear the language of the cosmos.
Chinese: 她被宗教裁判所折磨了数月。用难以启齿的工具和装置把她逼疯,然后,当他们玩腻了她,就把她扔进一间隔绝密文的牢房。平生第一次,她听不见宇宙的语言了。

English: For ((Caer)), It was like being deprived of ((air)). Not... that I can know for sure, because we were already separate. ##Whatever they did to me - to Caer, in those years - turned her into the High Confessor you know.
Chinese: 对((凯尔))来说,那就像被剥夺了((空气))。不……我没法确知,因为我们那时已经分离。##那些年他们对我——对凯尔——做的一切,把她变成了你所认识的至高忏悔者。

English: So wait - ((you're)) the ghost of the High Confessor?
Chinese: 等等——((你))是至高忏悔者的幽灵?

English: If you're thinking that we seem like completely different people, well... I'll take that as a compliment.
Chinese: 如果你在想,我们看起来简直判若两人,嗯……那我就当这是夸奖了。

English: If you're the same, can't you stop her?
Chinese: 既然你们是同一个人,你就不能阻止她吗?

English: We are ((not)) the same. I tried to talk to her, once - tried to make her see sense. It was... no use.
Chinese: 我们((不是))同一个人。我曾试着和她谈过一次——试着让她明白道理。没……有用。

English: At least the High Confessor has a plan.
Chinese: 至少至高忏悔者有计划。

English: Perhaps, but she is imprisoned in more ways than one. Her options are severely limited by her masters; and she is driven only by revenge.
Chinese: 或许吧,但她被囚禁的方式不止一种。她的选择被主子们严格限制;她心中只剩复仇。

English: Listen, stranger. The Caer in that coffin? She's but a shadow of her former self; a shrivelled corpse who barely clings to life.
Chinese: 听着,陌生人。棺材里的那个凯尔?她只是昔日自己的影子;一具勉强吊着命的干瘪残躯。

English: This godlet is the last remnant of who she once was. If you kill Danu here, there will be ((nothing)) left of Caer - nothing but a ((ghost)).
Chinese: 这位稚神是她昔日为人的最后残存。你若在这里杀了达努,凯尔就((什么都不剩))了——只剩一具((幽灵))。

English: ((Kill the godlet.))
Chinese: ((杀死稚神。))

English: <<You approach the godlet with the Void Knife. The being shrieks; an alien, ethereal noise that seems to resound through all your senses.>>
Chinese: <<你持虚空刀走向稚神。那存在发出尖叫;一种陌生而虚渺的声音,仿佛穿透你的所有感官。>>

English: <<You plunge the dagger into its throat. A pained wail seems to reverberate through your very being, and both the godlet and the knife dissipate into nothingness.>>
Chinese: <<你把匕首刺进它的喉咙。一声痛苦的哀嚎仿佛在你的存在深处回荡,稚神与刀一同化作虚无。>>

English: <<The ghost of Caer shrieks; an awful cry that descends into sobs.>> ##Stranger...
Chinese: <<凯尔的幽灵发出尖叫;一声凄厉的哭喊渐渐化为呜咽。>>##陌生人……

English: <<She wipes away ethereal tears.>> So you choose the life of an Inquisition puppet, then? ##<<She sniffs.>> So be it.
Chinese: <<她拭去虚渺的泪水。>>所以你选择了当宗教裁判所的傀儡?##<<她吸了吸鼻子。>>那便随你。

English: I won't desert you. Unlike that ((High Confessor)), I don't hold grudges; and what's at stake here is... too important.
Chinese: 我不会抛弃你。不像那个((至高忏悔者)),我不记仇;何况此处利害……太过重大。

English: But know that my faith in you has been shattered, stranger. ##Now... ((leave me)).
Chinese: 但你要知道,我对你的信任已经破碎,陌生人。##现在……((走开))。

English: ((Free the godlet. ))
Chinese: ((放走稚神。))

English: <<You approach the godlet with the Void Knife. The godlet shrieks; an alien, ethereal sound that seems to resound through all your senses.>>
Chinese: <<你持虚空刀走向稚神。稚神发出尖叫;一种陌生而虚渺的声音,仿佛穿透你的所有感官。>>

English: <<The knife cuts through its bonds with one hard strike, shattering the blade into a thousand pieces. The godlet is free. It chirrups, and a wave of warmth spreads through your body.>>
Chinese: <<刀锋狠狠一击割断束缚,刀身碎成千片。稚神自由了。它啾啾鸣叫,一股暖流传遍你的身体。>>

English: <<The ghost of Caer nods at you.>> Thank you dearly, stranger. Danu did not deserve such a cruel fate.
Chinese: <<凯尔的幽灵向你点头。>>万分感谢,陌生人。达努不该遭此横祸。

English: I'll see you back at the Blinding Light. Something tells me the Inquisition will not look favourably upon the High Confessor, for this.
Chinese: 炫光要塞再见。我有种预感,宗教裁判所不会因此对至高忏悔者客气。

English: ((Leave.))
A terrifying thing, is it not? It's hard to comprehend that it was made with human hands. Its arteries throb with all manner of deadly machines.
Chinese: 一个可怕的东西,不是吗?很难想象它竟出自人类之手。它的血管里搏动着各式各样致命的机械。

English: <<She swallows.>> Listen, stranger... I can see that this fight will not be easy. The path ahead cannot be trodden without bloodshed.
Chinese: <<她咽了口唾沫。>>听着,陌生人……我看得出这场战斗不会轻松。前方的路免不了血光。

English: Just know that whatever happens, the blame is not yours to bear. We are, as ever, dancing to Vela's tune.
Chinese: 只需记住,无论发生什么,过错都不该由你背负。我们一如既往,不过是踏着薇拉的调子起舞。

English: What do we have here? It seems as though some wretched soul, spat from a dank prison cell, has somehow stumbled into the most fateful moment in living memory. <<She grins.>>
Chinese: 瞧瞧这是谁?仿佛某个刚从阴湿牢房里吐出来的可怜灵魂,不知怎么就撞进了在世之人记忆中最决定性的时刻。<<她咧嘴笑。>>

English: The [[angel]] ((watches)) you, stranger. To its incomprehensible mind you are little more than an insect crawling on shit.
Chinese: 那位[[天使]]正((注视))着你,陌生人。在它那无法理解的头脑中,你不过是爬在粪便上的虫豸。

English: And yet here, in this plane of existence, it has no power without one such as you. It is a thing born of the void; it can think and feel only in cipher, and lacks the ((perspective)) of a mere mortal. To have agency in this place, it must merge with another.
Chinese: 然而在这里,在这个存在位面,没有你这样的存在,它便毫无力量。它是虚空所生之物;只能以密文思考和感受,缺少凡人的((视角))。要在此地行动,它必须与另一个存在融合。

English: This creature defies foresight, stranger. In the threads of prophecy this moment is an abyss through which I cannot see. For years I thought it was Vela who would stand at the precipice; but now I see that it is... ((You)).
Chinese: 这造物抗拒预见,陌生人。在预言的丝线中,这一刻是一道深不见底的深渊。多年来我以为站在悬崖边的会是薇拉;但现在我明白,那是……((你))。

English: I have proven my worth.
Chinese: 我已证明了自己的价值。

English: Your ((worth)), stranger? It is ever the folly of mortals that they account chance and privilege with ((divine providence)).
Chinese: 你的((价值)),陌生人?凡人的愚顽莫过于把机缘与特权当作((天意))。

English: It was merely the roll of a dice.
Chinese: 那不过是掷骰子罢了。

English: <<She smirks. >> Many in your position would claim sole responsibility for their successes. I'm glad you have the sense to see otherwise.
Chinese: <<她窃笑。>>许多身处你之位的人都会把成功独揽一身。很高兴你有头脑看到另一面。

English: These islands have long been the home of dreamers and fantasists. Their delusions have seeped into the fabric of the earth, waiting for one to reclaim them. The people here have hung their wishes on your shoulders, nothing more.
Chinese: 这些群岛长久以来是梦想家与空想家的家园。他们的妄想渗入了大地的织体,等待有人将它们收回。这里的人把愿望挂上了你的肩头,仅此而已。

English: But you should do well to remember that your power - ((all)) power - is borrowed. We are naught but conduits.
Chinese: 但你最好记住,你的力量——((一切))力量——都是借来的。我们不过是导管。

English: And now, whether by chance of skill, you wield more power than any before you. The last time this angel was roused, the whole world was destroyed. You could banish it - or you could ((merge)) with it, and succeed where those before you failed.
Chinese: 而如今,无论是机缘还是技艺,你握有的力量胜过所有前人。上次这位天使被唤醒时,整个世界毁灭了。你可以放逐它——也可以与它((融合)),在无数前人失败之处成功。

English: What will you do, I wonder?
Chinese: 你会怎么做呢,我很好奇?

English: Could this angel cause another World Rend?
Chinese: 这位天使会引发又一次世界撕裂吗?

English: I would ((like)) to tell you that the Emberians, four hundred years ago, used the angel with malice and stupidity, so as to doom the world to such a fate...
Chinese: 我倒((愿意))告诉你,四百年前的余烬人出于恶意与愚蠢使用天使,才把世界推向那种命运……

English: But the truth is, nobody truly knows what happened back then, or what could happen now. Vela was certain she could merge with the angel without triggering a syntax cascade - I am not so brazen as to say either way.
Chinese: 但真相是,没人真正知道当时发生了什么,或现在可能发生什么。薇拉确信自己能与天使融合而不触发句法级联——我可没那么厚脸皮,敢断言孰对孰错。

English: For someone who has spent her life predicting the future, it is somewhat of a novelty to admit: I have no idea.
Chinese: 对一个毕生预测未来的人而言,承认下面这话还真是新鲜:我不知道。

English: What should I do?
Chinese: 我该怎么做?

English: <<She sighs.>> I have long thought that to change the rules of cipher - to fundamentally alter the very ((fabric)) of existence - is a sin more shameful than I could imagine.
Chinese: <<她叹息。>>我长久以来认为,篡改密文的规则——从根本上改变存在的((织体))——是一种比我想象中更可耻的罪孽。

English: I believed this in my heart when I tried to stop Vela; but her will proved stronger, and in defying her I lost everything I ever held dear.
Chinese: 当我试图阻止薇拉时,我心中笃信这一点;但她的意志更为强大,而在违抗她的过程中,我失去了珍爱的一切。

English: And if I ever truly loved her, can't I also see that she was driven as much by love and beauty, as anger and ambition?
Chinese: 而若我真的爱过她,我难道不该也看到,驱动她的既有爱与美,也有愤怒与野心吗?

English: <<She smiles at you, weakly.>> The truth is, I am no longer a person; just an echo of one. I have no right to interfere with the living. ##Do as you wish, stranger.
Chinese: <<她虚弱地朝你微笑。>>说实话,我已不再是人;只是一个人的回声。我无权干涉生者的世界。##随心去做吧,陌生人。

English: Well, it's now or never.
Chinese: 好了,机不可失。

English: Good luck, stranger. <<She smiles, warmly.>> ##Or perhaps I should call you... ((friend.))
Chinese: 祝你好运,陌生人。<<她温暖地微笑。>>##或者,我该称你一声……((朋友))。

English: Good luck, stranger. If there is such a thing.
Chinese: 祝你好运,陌生人。如果真有这回事的话。
